About Us:
At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

The ITS Development team in the IT Services department, part of the Central Tech business unit, provides technical expertise to support internal technology platforms and services across the organisation. We are responsible for developing, maintaining, and evolving solutions that enable efficient IT operations, streamline business processes, and improve the employee experience. Our goal is to empower teams with reliable, scalable, and well-integrated technology that supports Booking.com’s business and technology communities.

Role Overview

Within the IT Services Development team, a software engineer takes part in designing, implementing and maintaining internal tools, systems, services and integrations which enable the workforce at Booking.com and other Booking Holdings brands to be mobile and productive.

The team’s services ownership scope includes, but is not limited to, the following aspects:

User provisioning mechanisms, interconnecting company’s Identity and Authorization Management system to 3rd party applications
Employee data synchronization and internal exposure services
Employee Benefits Program management service
Corporate offices meeting rooms management service
Employee communications management systems

Programming languages and key technologies used within the team are:

Hosting platforms: Booking Kubernetes Services (private cloud) / AWS / Mulesoft
Programming languages: Java, TypeScript
Other technologies used: Mulesoft, MySQL, Kafka, React

The team (along with the all the Tech & Product teams) uses agile methodology.

Designing and building software applications, automations and integration by using relevant development languages and technologies, and applying knowledge of systems, services and tools appropriate for the business area
Build template solutions on complex integration cases and liaise with our business stakeholders and traduce their business needs into Integration solutions.
Maintaining and supporting existing integration interfaces.
Createing technical design and actual implementation of solutions.
Owning a service end to end by actively monitoring application/integration health and performance, setting and monitoring relevant metrics and act accordingly when violated
Identify and resolve live production issues by mitigating the customer impact within SLA
Evaluating possible architecture solutions by taking into account cost, business requirements, technology requirements and emerging technologies
Identifying opportunities for process, system and structural improvements (i.e performance gains) by examining and evaluating current process flows, methods and standards
Drive and implement solutions for automations or new functionalities in the reliability tools
Delivering clear, well-structured, and meaningful information to a target audience by using suitable communication mediums and language tailored to the audience

Role Qualifications And Requirements

Min 5+ years of experience in the IT industry
Minimum of 3 years software development experience.
Strong working knowledge and experience with Java / SpringBoot
Good understanding of concepts such as Mulesoft, EDA, MOA, SOA, SOAP, REST APIs, RESTful, RPC/RFC, event streams such as Kafka and different integration patterns.
Integration platform experience with Mule 4.x, CloudHub 1.0, (Ideally some experience on CloudHub 2.0)
Exposure to a variety of enterprise architectures from a large monolithic architecture to hybrid landscapes consisting of distributed systems and microservices and event-driven architectures.
Experience of API led design using RAML/OAS and experience of supporting APIs through the full API lifecycle and system observability is a plus (Graphite, Grafana etc.)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication; written and spoken and experience working with non-technical stakeholders

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

Du bist interessiert an der Stelle als Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Developer (m/w/d) – Mannheim bei Aliru GmbH
?

Auf Instaffo kannst du dich für diesen und weitere Jobs ohne großen Aufwand bewerben. Erstelle dein Profil in unter 2 Minuten und starte den Bewerbungsprozess mit nur wenigen Klicks.

Anforderungen

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland
erforderlich ist.

Sprache: Deutsch - Verhandlungssicher (C2)

Ausbildung: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (B.Sc. / M.Sc.) mit dem Schwerpunkt (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine Ausbildung mit vergleichbarer Qualifikation. Wichtiger als dein schulischer Werdegang ist uns aber, dass du fachlich stark bist und Verantwortung übernehmen willst.
Erfahrung: Du hast bereits mehrere Beratungs- und Umsetzungsprojekte im CRM-/Business-Software-Umfeld erfolgreich begleitet und fühlst dich besonders in der technischen Konzeption und Umsetzung sicher. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder vergleichbaren Plattformen mit. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Teams oder Projekten ist wünschenswert; disziplinarische Führungserfahrung ist ein zusätzliches Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Technisches Know-how: C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript gehören zu deinem Werkzeugkasten. Du legst Wert auf sauberen, wartbaren Code und entwickelst Lösungen mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit.
Persönlichkeit: Du denkst strukturiert, kommunizierst offen und direkt und kannst fachliche Anforderungen in durchdachte technische Lösungen übersetzen. Die Kombination aus technischer Tiefe, Eigeninitiative und direktem Kundenkontakt passt perfekt zu dir.
Begeisterung: Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, fachlich vorangehen und dein Wissen nicht nur in Projekte, sondern auch in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Teams einbringen.
Kommunikation: Dein Profil wird abgerundet durch sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie ein souveränes Auftreten in Workshops, Kundenterminen und Pitch-Terminen.

Tätigkeiten

Microsoft Dynamics 365 (CRM): Du berätst unsere Kunden bei anspruchsvollen CRM-Projekten, analysierst ihre Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / Customer Service / Marketing / Field Service).
Lösungsdesign & Entwicklung: Du konzipierst und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen mit C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript und legst dabei großen Wert auf sauberen Code, Qualität und Wartbarkeit.
Anforderungen technisch übersetzen: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und Consultants zusammen, verstehst fachliche Anforderungen und überführst sie in durchdachte technische Konzepte.
Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du bewertest Lösungswege, unterstützt bei der Priorisierung technischer Themen und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte strukturiert und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
Wissen weitergeben: Du teilst deine Erfahrung im Team, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei komplexen Fragestellungen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer technischen Standards ein.
Workshops & Kundentermine: Du bringst deine technische Expertise in Workshops, Präsentationen und Pitch-Terminen ein und hilfst so dabei, Kunden von unseren Lösungen zu überzeugen und neue Projekte zu gewinnen.

Team

Warum wir?

Technische Verantwortung mit echtem Einfluss: Du bringst dein Know-how aktiv in unsere Projekte und die Weiterentwicklung des Teams ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Lösungen und unterstützt andere bei komplexen Fragestellungen.
Qualität statt Standardlösungen: Dich erwarten vielseitige CRM-Projekte, in denen du saubere, wartbare und nachhaltige Lösungen entwickelst – mit dem Anspruch, nicht nur funktionierenden, sondern wirklich guten Code zu schreiben.
Echte Wertschätzung: Wenn du Teil unseres Teams wirst, dann haben wir dich auserwählt. Das heißt, dass uns deine Leistungen, dein Wohlergehen sowie deine Meinung sehr viel bedeuten – und das zeigen wir auch.
Deine Weiterentwicklung ist unser Erfolg: Daher gibt es regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, die dein Verbesserungspotenzial auslegen. Hast du Interesse an einer Weiterbildung oder einem Kurs, der dich begeistert und deine Fähigkeiten stärkt? Sprich uns gerne an – wir sind immer offen für deine Ideen!
Mitgestaltung ausdrücklich erwünscht: Deine Ideen zu Architektur, Prozessen, Teamaufbau oder Kundenprojekten sind willkommen. Wenn etwas besser geht, hören wir zu.
Perspektive über die Rolle hinaus: Wenn du neben der fachlichen Führung auch Lust auf disziplinarische Verantwortung hast, bieten wir dir auch dafür die passende Entwicklungsperspektive.

Über das Unternehmen

Wir begleiten Unternehmen mit CRM-/Dynamics-Projekten und haben mit Sally gleichzeitig unser eigenes SaaS-Produkt erfolgreich am Markt platziert, das wir kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Dabei zählt für uns nicht nur, was wir tun, sondern auch, wie wir es tun: mit viel Ambition, dem richtigen Mindset und dem klaren Anspruch, etwas Großes aufzubauen. Bei uns muss nicht immer alles perfekt laufen – wichtig ist, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, aus Fehlern lernst und daran wächst. Genau darin liegt für uns echtes Wachstum. Bei Aliru arbeitest du nicht einfach nur mit, sondern entwickelst dich fachlich und persönlich weiter – mit Erfahrungen, von denen du nicht nur im Job, sondern auch fürs Leben profitierst.

jobs.title: Azure AI Engineer - Agentic Systems (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit.
Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive.
Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse.
LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung.
Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher.
Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung.

DEIN PROFIL

Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz.
Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit.
Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET.
LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle.
Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus.
Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Avanade is a global leader in digital, cloud, and AI‑driven solutions. As a joint venture between Microsoft and Accenture, we are the world’s largest consulting company fully focused on Microsoft technologies.

We help our clients design, build, and scale innovative solutions across Cloud, Applications, Data & AI, and Security, based on a strong #PeopleFirst culture.

Your Role

As an AI Software Engineer (Full stack, Frontend, Backend)
, you design, develop, and integrate AI
‑ enabled and Generative AI
‑ powered solutions
into modern applications.

You work hands‑on across the full stack while applying AI technologies to enhance user experiences, automate processes, and deliver measurable business value.

Depending on your experience, you may also lead small development teams, mentor colleagues, and contribute to solution design and technical decision
‑ making
.

You collaborate closely with product owners, designers, architects, and other engineers as part of multidisciplinary delivery teams.

Your Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure full‑stack applications
Integrate Generative AI capabilities into applications and development workflows
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI agents to support automation and improved user interaction
Implement AI‑driven features using modern frameworks, APIs, and services
Collaborate with designers, product owners, and fellow developers to deliver high‑quality software
Participate across the entire software lifecycle, from requirements analysis to production deployment and support
Write clean, maintainable, and well‑tested code aligned with best practices
Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve technical issues across applications and AI components
Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and actively contribute to continuous improvement

Your Profile

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years of professional experience in software or full‑stack development
Hands‑on experience using AI and Generative AI tools in application development
Proven experience designing and deploying Generative AI agents or AI‑powered features
Strong experience with front‑end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Solid backend/API development experience with Python, .NET Core, Node.js
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g. SQL Server, Cosmos DB)
Understanding of containers and container orchestration
Experience with Azure or other major cloud platforms
Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and DevOps practices
Strong problem‑solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
Fluency in German and English are a mandatory requirement

Qualifications

Nice to Have

Experience leading or mentoring development teams
Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Copilot, AI orchestration frameworks, or agent frameworks
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud‑native architectures
Background in consulting or customer‑facing project delivery

What Sets You Apart

Strong interest in applying AI to real‑world business problems
Hands‑on, solution‑oriented mindset
Ability to explain complex technical topics in a clear and structured way
High level of ownership, curiosity, and continuous‑learning attitude
Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international teams

What We Offer

Opportunity to work for the Microsoft Global Alliance Partner of the Year
Access to extensive learning and certification programs, including AI and cloud technologies
Collaboration with experienced architects, AI specialists, and engineers globally
Clear career paths toward Senior AI Developer, Technical Lead, or AI Architect
Competitive, performance‑based compensation aligned with your experience and location
Compensation varies depending on role, location, experience, and skill set.
We place great importance on performance-based and competitive remuneration and, depending on your experience and qualifications, offer you an attractive compensation package.

Learn More About Some Of Our Benefits Here.

The Perfect Place to Work

More than 60,000 professionals, 26 countries, and one universe — that’s Avanade. No matter the digital challenge, we find the solution within the Microsoft ecosystem. Because one thing is clear: we come from good stock. Accenture LLP and Microsoft Corporation brought us into being in the year 2000. Naturally, we skillfully combine the best of both worlds.

If you decide to contribute your skills and individual talents at Avanade, you will be rewarded with unique experiences, unlimited learning opportunities, and ambitious growth.

And while we continue to invest in our diverse and inclusive culture — becoming even more innovative and creative along the way — we ensure that our clients benefit from our technological innovations and that our communities thrive. You will become part of a smart team that supports, encourages, guides you, and relies on your expertise. The perfect start at a company founded to implement mission‑critical, leading technology solutions while also striving to improve the way people work, interact, and live.

Do What Matters

We believe that inclusive and diverse teams can overcome any challenge — if you face challenges with passion and courage, you are exactly right with us. Your application is welcome regardless of your background, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender. With us, you can simply be yourself. Diversity in all its forms is close to our hearts and a core part of Avanade’s culture.

jobs.title: Engineer Quality Assurance (m/w/d) - Test Strategy & AI
jobs.description:
Kennziffer: 894

Your Job Description

With our IIoT platform moneo, we connect sensor data, software, and AI to help companies monitor, analyze and optimize their machines and systems more intelligently. As part of our Quality team, you will support product teams in integrating quality into their daily work in a sustainable and self-driven way. In this role, you will act as an enabler, coach and technology advocate. At the same time, you will drive modern testing and automation approaches and actively promote the use of AI, helping shape the future of software quality.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Developing a modern and scalable test strategy for our moneo software products
Designing tools, frameworks and automation solutions for testing and quality engineering
Shaping modern testing and automation practices and developing innovative solutions using state-of-the-art AI tools
Establishing meaningful quality metrics and ensuring transparency regarding the quality status of our products
Providing expert guidance to product development teams and supporting them in independently integrating quality into their development processes
Actively supporting capability building in the areas of AI-assisted work and test strategy

Your Profile

You are passionate about software quality and enjoy helping others build better products. You see quality not as a control function, but as a shared responsibility. You are approachable, can communicate knowledge clearly and know how to inspire different teams to embrace new ideas. You view modern technologies, especially AI, as an opportunity to solve challenges more quickly and intelligently. You enjoy working independently, take a pragmatic approach and maintain a holistic perspective even when dealing with complex issues.

Required Qualifications

Several years of professional experience in software development, testing and/or quality assurance
Experience with modern test strategies, test automation and quality engineering in professional software environments
Knowledge of C#/.NET, ideally combined with experience in TypeScript and Playwright, and a willingness to learn additional technologies and programming languages
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or comparable solutions
Experience in coaching, mentoring or guiding teams is advantageous
Good German and excellent English language skills, as well as a self-driven and independent way of working, are essential

jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany, plus a senior regional position in the north-eastern United States.
Home-based or hybrid working with regular domestic and international travel to manufacturing sites.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Application Engineer:

Together with the Project Managers, defines implementation and configuration approaches within approved standards.
Stops or rejects a technical deployment when readiness or acceptance criteria are not met.
Recommends fixes, improvements and standard changes based on operational evidence.
Escalates architecture, security, scope and vendor-performance risks.
The role does not own application strategy, roadmap, backlog or commercial vendor decisions, does not act only as a software developer without integration, testing, support and site responsibilities, does not replace the plant's operational ownership or bypass agreed OT governance, and does not approve material deviations from global standards without the relevant owner or authority.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: priorities, scope, standards, acceptance and escalation of commercial or roadmap matters.
Plant operations and local OT teams: site readiness, deployment activities, onboarding, training, support and operational handover.
Developers, delivery leads and Scrum Masters: build activities, defect resolution, planning and release execution.
Infrastructure and cybersecurity teams: interfaces, security controls, architecture dependencies and technical risk.
Software vendors and system integrators: technical quality, delivery evidence, testing and issue resolution.
Business and functional stakeholders (production, quality, maintenance, supply chain): technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions affecting plant operations.
Project managers: rollout planning and execution; sequencing, dependencies and escalation of deviations.

At AG Solution, we build intelligent solutions for the process industry, combining automation, process control, data management, and MES/MOM systems to help manufacturers reach operational excellence.

Now part of the Quariq Group, we are one of Europe’s leading Industry 4.0 partners
, with more than 400 engineers and consultants working across Europe, the UK, and the US.

Driven by People. Powered by Technology.

Our success starts with our people
. We invest in growth through continuous learning, mentorship, and our AG Academy, ensuring every colleague has the opportunity to develop their skills and career. AG Solution is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We believe that innovation happens when people feel trusted, connected, and inspired.

A Global Team with a Human Touch

With offices in over 15 cities worldwide
, we bring together diverse expertise and perspectives — from Antwerp to Barcelona, Rotterdam to Lyon, and New York to Krakow.

At AG Solution, you’ll work on meaningful projects that drive efficiency, sustainability, and digital transformation for leading manufacturers worldwide.

Unsere Software wird weltweit für das Risiko-Management bei Großprojekten eingesetzt,
sowohl im eigenen Beratungsgeschäft als auch von unseren Kunden. Für die
Weiterentwicklung unserer Desktop-Applikation, einer komplexen WPF-Anwendung auf Basis

Innsbruck

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Innsbruck ab sofort:

.NET / WPF Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)

40 h/Woche

Deine Aufgaben:

• Weiterentwicklung unserer WPF-Desktop-Anwendung in C# und .NET, vom
Datenmodell und Backend bis zur Benutzeroberfläche (XAML, MVVM).
• Refactoring von Legacy-Code, Einführung von Unit- und Integrationstests für
bestehende und neue Features.
• Entwicklung von Begleit-Tools rund um die Hauptanwendung.
• Technische Dokumentation und erklär Hilfen für Anwender.
• Mit wachsender Produktkenntnis: Support und direkter Austausch mit Partnern und
Kunden.

Deine Qualifikation:

• Echte Freude am Programmieren: Du willst Code schreiben, den man in einem halben
Jahr noch versteht. Dass die elegante Lösung meist erst im zweiten oder dritten
Durchgang entsteht, ist für Dich Teil des Handwerks – und Du weißt trotzdem, wann
eine Lösung fertig ist.
• Du kommunizierst gerne offen und arbeitest mit anderen zusammen, nicht isoliert für
Dich.
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, idealerweise mit technischer oder
analytischer Ausrichtung (Informatik, HTL, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Architektur oder
vergleichbar).
• Entweder mehrjährige Erfahrung mit C# und .NET, idealerweise mit WPF - oder
nachweisbare Programmierpraxis aus einem anderen technischen Umfeld, etwa durch
eigene Tools oder Projekte.
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1/C2); die fachliche Abstimmung
und Dokumentation finden bei uns durchgängig auf Deutsch statt. Gute
Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil.

Das bieten wir Ihnen:

• Strukturierte Einarbeitung direkt am Code. Dein Gestaltungsspielraum wächst mit
Deiner Produktkenntnis.

entstehen im Gespräch, umgesetzt wird dann eigenverantwortlich.
• Direktes Feedback zu Deiner Arbeit durch Zusammenarbeit mit Projektmanagern und
Kunden - Du siehst Deinen Code live im Einsatz.
• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeitmodell) mit eigenem Entwickler-Notebook, Homeoffice-
Zeiten nach Vereinbarung möglich.
• Moderne, zentral gelegene Arbeitsräume gegenüber der Olympiaworld Innsbruck.
• Ein Monatsgehalt ab EUR 4.000 brutto auf Basis von 14 Gehältern. Einschlägige
Erfahrung honorieren wir mit entsprechender Überzahlung.

Operating under the EthiFinance brand, the combined group brings together complementary expertise in sustainability, credit ratings, data, analytics and technology to create a leading independent European player with global capabilities.

Today, the group brings together more than 300 experts across Europe, the United States, India and Japan, serving more than 500 clients and providing coverage on more than 10,000 companies worldwide. This unique combination of financial expertise, ESG intelligence and technology enables us to support financial institutions and corporates in an increasingly complex and fast-evolving market environment.

As the sustainable finance market continues to evolve, EthiFinance is building a strong European alternative that combines deep local expertise with international reach, helping clients better understand and manage both financial and non-financial risks.

jobs.title: Engineering Compliance and CSV Manager
jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS, and we're looking for someone to take the role of Engineering Compliance Manager and CSV & Process Validation Manager
in our medical device team.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You Will

As CSV & Process Validation Manager, prove our systems and processes work and produce reliable evidence.

Own the computer system validation and process validation processes for the AMBOSS medical device portfolio — procedures, templates and work instructions — keeping them aligned with MDR and ISO 13485 and updated based on audit findings and team feedback.
Maintain the inventory of systems in scope and decide, risk-based, which need validation and to what depth; plan, execute and document that validation and keep systems in a validated state as they change.
Concentrate validation effort where the evidence is produced — test management, defect tracking, build/release tooling and automated pipeline steps whose output can't be fully verified by inspection alone — confirming these systems and processes reliably produce trustworthy, intended results.
Own the resulting evidence and represent it directly to auditors and regulators; raise, document and own validation deviations and the associated CAPAs through to resolution.

As Engineering Compliance Manager, ensure the medical device product itself is built compliantly, from a day-to-day engineering work perspective

Own compliant execution of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, verification, release — against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1
Define the compliance requirements and gates in our delivery pipeline against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 (traceability tagging, release criteria, automated checks) and partner with engineering to implement them.
Operate the compliance gate in the release flow, keeping the trace intact from user requirement through verification to released evidence. Sign off each release as a required gate; no release ships without your approval.
Ensure engineering-related Technical Documentation deliverables are compliant with regulatory and QMS requirements
Onboard and train software engineers on compliance requirements and how to work within them day-to-day.
Act as the point of contact for audits and technical reviews on engineering-related topics, representing the team's compliance posture to auditors and Notified Body reviewers.
Drive resolution of audit findings and deficiencies affecting engineering.
Assess the engineering impact of Design Changes before they are implemented.
Identify and drive adoption of tooling the team is missing to work compliantly — both inside the QMS and on the engineering side.

You Bring

Knowledge of medical devices or another regulated industry (pharma, biotech, IVD). Experience in, or eagerness to learn, computer system validation and/or process validation, including risk-based scoping of validation effort, is a plus.
Working knowledge of MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 as they apply to software.
Familiarity with software engineering, and enough depth in our stack (React, Python, PHP, Go; AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD) to review pipelines, tests and release processes with engineers as a peer.
Experience representing validation documentation and rationale to auditors and inspectors.
Experience assessing the engineering/technical impact of Design Changes within a regulated development process.
Excellent written and spoken English

You Enjoy

Working closely with engineers, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs — able to challenge and be challenged on technical detail.
Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to explain complex validation requirements to cross-functional stakeholders
Structured, detail-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with practical, workable processes for development teams

Benefits

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health and work-life harmony.

Check out all of our employee benefits here: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone — regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity — is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfill our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

Even if you don't meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Job Description

Reliable data, resilient services and scalable architectures are at the heart of every CRM interaction at idealo. As a Staff Engineer,
you'll shape the technical foundation behind identity resolution, subscriptions, data flows, and message delivery while ensuring GDPR compliance and supporting personalized user experiences.

This role combines backend engineering, data engineering and architectural leadership
. You'll influence how data flows across systems, how services communicate through event-driven architectures, and how technical decisions support idealo's long-term CRM strategy. Working closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers and Product Managers, you'll help define technical direction across multiple domains.

You'll work with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Braze, Snowflake and AWS services including Glue, Lambda and S3 in a modern cloud-native architecture
. From data ingestion and transformation to customer-facing activation, you'll help build reliable systems that teams across idealo depend on every day. When new CRM capabilities go live, you'll see the direct impact of your work in millions of customer interactions.

The position is available in full or part-time.

About Your New Role

Design, implement, maintain, and evolve reliable and scalable software systems and data flows for CRM and user engagement use cases. 
Stay hands-on by designing and developing cloud-native microservices, event-driven applications and backend services with a strong focus on performance, security and operational excellence.
Lead technical initiatives within and across the team to align technical solutions with business needs.
Drive continuous improvements across software development, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, observability, and monitoring while evaluating new technologies where they add measurable value.
Mentor engineers through technical guidance, architecture discussions and code reviews, fostering a collaborative engineering culture focused on sustainable technical excellence.

Job Requirements

Skills & Requirements

You bring extensive experience building cloud-native software systems on AWS and designing distributed, event-driven architectures using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Kafka and modern backend technologies.
You have deep expertise in data architecture, data warehousing, ETL processes and data integration, combined with hands-on experience working with technologies such as Glue, S3 and MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
You are experienced with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes, and are familiar with serverless architectures, AWS Lambda and modern CI/CD practices.
You have a strong understanding of software quality, security and reliability, including authentication, encryption, automated testing and secure software development practices.
You have a proven track record of leading complex technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions and aligning engineering work across teams without formal people management responsibility.
You take ownership and independently drive topics forward. The Confidence to speak up and challenge ideas constructively, paired with openness to diverse perspectives.

At idealo you can expect

You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.
In need of additional support in any areas of your life? We offer free counseling and support in all areas of life (professional, private, family, health, etc.) in cooperation with the pme-Familienservice.
You want full flexibility on your way to work and beyond? No problem with a job bike or Deutschlandticket - and it's environmentally friendly, too!
Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.
And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

Perspektiven für die Zukunft

You will be working in Warsaw. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark, Austria, Germany, etc. English is the corporate language and is used in all communication.

2+ years of experience in software engineering using C# and .NET Development
Experience with infrastructure as code preferably using Arm, Bicep, PowerShell and Azure pipelines
You have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or similar

Understanding of Lean Agile practices, values and principles are a plus

Continually looking for ways to improve what we do and how we do it

Basic experience with UI development using WPF, XAML or .NET MAUI.

Experience developing software for medical devices, healthcare or another regulated industry.

jobs.title: Principal Architect (1C9D035)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a financial technology business that provides banks with the data intelligence behind personalised digital banking. Its platform runs in demanding client environments, with much of the estate currently deployed on-premises and an active migration towards cloud.

As Principal Architect, you'll own the architecture of the whole platform: services, data, integrations, deployment models and the boundaries between them. Reporting directly to the CTO, you'll set technical direction, make difficult trade-offs and remain accountable for whether the architecture supports the business as it scales.

The business is undertaking a funded platform transformation spanning performance, architecture and AI. This is not a review-and-advise position or a programme management role. You'll draft the target architecture, defend it with engineers and customers, and stay close to implementation so you can correct drift early. The work is about shaping the technical outcome while ensuring today's delivery remains consistent with the platform's longer-term direction.

The Role

Define and own the target architecture, establishing the platform structure and clear service boundaries that engineers can use to make implementation decisions.
Shape the technical transformation from on-premises to cloud, from MSSQL to PostgreSQL and from legacy systems to a coherent platform. Stay close enough to delivery to identify divergence before it becomes entrenched.
Document architectural decisions through RFCs, architecture decision records and technical strategy. Write clearly enough that teams can understand the rationale, resolve debates and act on the agreed direction.
Embed AI as a first-class architectural concern across services, data pipelines and the software development lifecycle, rather than treating it only as an additional feature.
Explain and defend the architecture with both internal engineers and bank-side architects, balancing technical credibility with clear communication about trade-offs.
Make decisions that work across on-premises client installations and cloud environments, maintaining practical awareness of both during the migration.

What We're Looking For

Ownership of a distributed, data-heavy platform architecture in production, with significant customer expectations. Designing a system in isolation is not enough; you should be able to explain how your decisions held up in operation.
Experience moving a live system from one architecture to another without stopping the business, with an honest account of the costs, compromises and lessons.
Deep C# and .NET knowledge, strong MSSQL and PostgreSQL experience, and practical exposure to both on-premises and cloud systems. You'll need to read implementation code critically, not operate solely at diagram level.
Hands-on understanding of Azure, Kafka, Kubernetes, Helm charts and distributed systems at scale.
Clear technical writing, demonstrated through RFCs, decision records or public technical communication. You should be able to turn an architectural judgement into an explicit, usable decision.
Credibility with engineers and customers, including bank architects who will challenge the proposed direction.
An active approach to reasoning about how AI changes architecture and engineering practice, including use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

Relevant Desirable Experience

RabbitMQ, Terraform, GCP or Python.
Fintech or another regulated industry where technical decisions must work within demanding client constraints.

Working Environment

This is a B2B contract engagement with two office days and three remote days each week. The source lists equity participation through an employee share option programme, private healthcare and support for wellbeing and everyday working costs. The role combines a direct reporting line to the CTO with authority to set technical direction and accountability for the resulting architecture.

Interview Process

A 30-minute screening call covers transformations you've led and what you learned. A 60-minute CTO discussion explores architecture, trade-offs and change at scale. A 90-minute architecture deep-dive uses a real platform problem, with AI tools welcome. The employer states that a decision or offer follows within ten days of the final interview.

This could suit a principal or platform architect who has already led a live technical transformation and wants whole-platform ownership while remaining close to code, engineering decisions and customer requirements.

NORION BANKS ERBJUDANDE TILL DIG

För oss är det självklart att varje individs utveckling värdesätts högt vilket innebär ett stort fokus på självledarskap och kompetensutveckling. Vi erbjuder dig ett spännande bolag med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, löpande kompetensutveckling och gemensamma aktiviteter på och utanför arbetsplatsen.

Företagsbeskrivning

AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

Jobbeskrivning

Är du en helt vanlig eller ovanlig back-end-utvecklare, som vill ha roligt på jobbet, samarbeta med andra, bidra med din kompetens, ha en stöttande chef och vara del av ett riktigt härligt team i Uppsala?
Bra, för precis det kan vi erbjuda dig!

I din roll som konsult kommer du att vara ansvarig för att utveckla och underhålla back-end-komponenter i olika projekt. Rollen innebär att arbeta både självständigt och i team, t.ex. genom att ensam eller tillsammans med kollegor ta ansvar för hela back-end-delen av ett projekt.

Vi driver både små och stora projekt från Uppsala och har kunder inom flera olika branscher, t.ex. offentlig sektor och samhällsviktig verksamhet. Din vardag kommer se lite olika ut beroende på projekt, kund och uppdrag - och den variationen tror jag att du tycker känns kul!

På kontoret i Uppsala finns ca 50 personer inom IT och digitalisering - det vill säga gott om både juniora och seniora kollegor att ta hjälp av.

Kvalifikationer

Dina tekniska färdigheter är förstås viktiga men vad du har att bidra med som person är lika viktigt det. I den här rollen behöver du t.ex. trivas med att samarbeta i team och dela ut och ta emot feedback, tycka att det är intressant när omständigheter förändras (t.ex. att du behöver lära dig en ny teknik eller nya arbetsuppgifter, byta kund, team eller projekt etc.), du motiveras av att hjälpa andra (t.ex. föreslå en teknisk förändring som är till hjälp för kunden) och du drar dig inte för att själv ta hjälp om du kör fast.

För att komma in med rätt tekniska förutsättningar tror vi att du:

Har minst 3 års erfarenhet av C#/.NET-utveckling
Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med REST API:er
Har erfarenhet av Azure och kunskap om DevOps och dess processer
Har erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server

Meriterande:

Erfarenhet av WPF
Erfarenhet av containerteknik (Podman, Kubernetes)
Erfarenhet av testdriven utveckling (TDD)
Erfarenhet av GIS

Utöver det är du svensk medborgare* och behärskar svenska i tal och skrift, då svenska krävs i kontakt med kollegor och kunder. Ett extra plus i kanten om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult!

För vissa uppdrag hos myndighet, region eller kommun krävs svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning.

Ytterligare information

Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-30

Create robust integration layers connecting internal systems and external parties.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Product Tech
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if your leadership could shape large-scale, business-critical digital products across a global organization? At H&M Tech, the Engineering Manager plays a critical leadership role, accountable for technical execution, delivery quality, and operational excellence.

The Product domain provides capabilities to design, create, source, and produce customer‑relevant assortments. It covers the full product lifecycle from product design, sourcing, purchasing, to production execution, and is organized into four focus areas that each own a distinct part of this lifecycle. The Product team will support the Production Office with technology and data use cases that help colleagues explore opportunities, improve decision-making, automate manual work, and create measurable value in production processes.

We are currently recruiting for 3 Engineering Manager positions
within our Product domain. These opportunities span the Product & Purchase
and Product Sourcing
areas, where you will lead one of our engineering teams supporting Sourcing Partnership Flow, Purchase Flow, or Labels & Tags

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Strategic & Delivery Leadership

Own end-to-end technical delivery for one or more large-scale and complex products or services.
In service contexts, own both roadmap and delivery accountability; in product contexts, partner with Product Managers to shape execution.
Translate business and product goals into clear technical direction, execution plans, and measurable outcomes across technology and data-enabled products.
Partner with Production Office stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver technology and data use cases that solve real operational needs and improve ways of working.
Work in close dual leadership with the Product Manager to balance product priorities, technical feasibility, delivery capacity, and long-term scalability.
Secure and allocate engineering capacity across multiple teams aligned with strategic priorities.
Establish scalable, secure, and resilient data platforms, pipelines, and data products that support analytics, experimentation, and operational use cases.
Lead through senior engineers while retaining overall accountability for engineering quality, delivery timelines, consistent standards, and operational excellence.

Operational Excellence

Shape and enforce engineering quality, simplification, and continuous improvement across teams.
Define and monitor KPIs to drive operational performance and business outcomes.
Ensure stable, resilient, compliant, and secure operations, including effective incident handling and adherence to architectural standards.
Lead proactive management of risks, dependencies, and technical debt.
Embed responsible technology practices into delivery, including privacy, security, bias awareness, monitoring, and clear operational ownership.
Oversee vendor and managed service delivery, ensuring performance, compliance, contractual alignment, and cost efficiency.

Financial Accountability

Own and manage tech costs (budget, forecast, actuals) across large-scale products or services.
Ensure strong financial discipline and cost efficiency aligned with TCO objectives.
Contribute to investment planning and prioritization aligned with business goals.

People & Culture

Lead, coach, mentor, and develop senior engineers, leaders, and teams while setting best practices for engineering excellence.
Build high-performing, inclusive, and psychologically safe environments in the team.
Ensure teams have the right competencies, structure, and support to succeed.
Promote sustainable ways of working and support team well-being.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a senior technical leader influencing enterprise-level decisions and priorities.
Collaborate with product, architecture, security, and business stakeholders to align direction.

Ensure transparency with clear communication of progress, risks, and dependencies.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will lead an engineering team within one of our Product Tech areas—Product & Purchase or Product Sourcing—supporting one of the strategic product teams: Sourcing Partnership Flow, Purchase Flow, or Labels & Tags. You will lead a Product team consisting of various Engineers and operate at the intersection of engineering, data, product, architecture, and business. The team will work closely with the Production Office to understand concrete use cases, shape scalable data and technology solutions, and turn business needs into reliable products that support production teams in their daily work.

You will work in dual leadership with the Product Manager, where you bring engineering leadership, delivery accountability, technical direction, and operational excellence while the Product Manager drives product vision, prioritization, and value realization. Together, you will align priorities, shape the roadmap, and ensure data and digital capabilities are designed, built, governed, and scaled across the Product in close collaboration with architects, specialists, security, analytics, and senior stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an experienced 10+ years
engineering leader with a strong track record of delivering complex, large-scale technology solutions. You bring deep technical understanding combined with impactful leadership, enabling teams and leaders to perform at their best.

You thrive in complexity and ambiguity, confidently making trade-offs that balance short-term delivery with long-term scalability, resilience, and quality.

You bring:

Strong experience in s
oftware development, with a solid hands-on background in .NET / C#
.
Strong experience working with Microsoft Azure
and cloud-based technologies.
Corporate leadership experience with direct budget responsibility,
including planning, forecasting, prioritization, cost management and accountability for budget outcomes.
Proven people leadership experience, including recruitment, performance management, coaching, feedback and employee development.
Ownership of delivery outcomes from planning through execution, with accountability for scope, timeline, quality, risks and dependencies.
Engineering leadership in a corporate custom software development environment using Microsoft technologies, including Azure.
Strong technical understanding of modern engineering practices, including agile, DevOps, scalable architecture, cloud platforms, and confidence working closely with engineers on technical decisions and delivery.
Ability to balance business value, technical feasibility, delivery capacity, and long-term scalability while creating clarity across product, engineering, architecture, and business.
Experience working with vendors and external partners.

WHO WE ARE
​

H&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

Help us re-imagine fashion and together we will re-shape our industry. Learn more about H&M here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
​

At H&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

We offer all our employees at H&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.

JOIN US
​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

Kan Unity och C# på djupet, det är kärnan i allt vi bygger
Har jobbat med UI Toolkit
Är van att profilera och optimera Unity-applikationer

God engelska i tal och skrift, eftersom våra kunder är internationella

jobs.title: Insurance Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary

We're looking for our first dedicated engineer for the insurance team - someone who wants to own the technical infrastructure behind how we price, analyze, and build insurance products. You'll build a truly great pricing engine, one that puts Lassie at the absolute top of the industry from a pricing perspective, and equip the insurance team with AI-powered analysis tooling and agents so they can move fast on pricing analysis and actuarial work without waiting on tech. Working closely with our tech team, you'll also contribute to projects across our insurance products more broadly - and to building something exceptional.

About Lassie

Pet parents have been stuck for too long with slow claims, confusing policies, and providers that treat their pet like a policy number instead of a member of the family. Lassie is the opposite: the go-to platform for managing every part of pet parenthood - health, insurance, payments, products, services and community - built around the pet and the people who love them. We've raised $75M in Series C, we're live in Sweden, Germany, France and the UK, and we're just getting started.

As a fast-growing scale-up, we hold ourselves to a high bar when it comes to our work: real ownership, fast execution, and decisions made like the business depends on them, because it does. Three values shape how we work:

Speed Machine - we move fast while others hesitate

Packed with Passion - we care deeply about our work and the pet parents we do it for

Copied Since 2021 - we don't follow trends, we create them.

We look for people who already work this way: people who care deeply, deliver fast, and want to help set the standard the rest of the industry ends up following.

Tasks

Own the pricing engine end to end: architecture, development, deployment, optimisation and maintenance

Build AI-powered analysis tooling and agents that let the insurance team move faster on pricing analysis and actuarial work, without waiting on tech

Build, improve and maintain high-frequency price updates, along with the monitoring and testing that let pricing changes ship fast with confidence, not risk

Act as the technical counterpart to our tech team from within the insurance team

Be scrappy and hands-on with whatever the work needs

Help set the bar for insurance engineering quality and how insurance engineering works at Lassie

Requirements

5+ years of experience as a developer, with a track record of owning systems end to end

Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or TypeScript, and comfortable working with data stores and warehouses like MongoDB and BigQuery

Fluent in English, both speaking and writing

Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills

Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

Genuine analytical interest and drive for optimising pricing and winning customers

High ability for shipping and learning extraordinarily quickly

You take ownership without waiting to be told. You see what needs fixing and you fix it

Bonus: Experience with AWS

Work-model: This role is based in Stockholm, where we work 3 days per week at the office.

IVRS (Integration, Verification, Release and Support) is a department within Grid Integration Modular Advanced Control (GI MACH), working with securing the quality of the MACH platform, the brain of the HVDC station. We are responsible for verification of the MACH Platform towards high level requirements and for releasing the platform to our customers.

IVRS is developing a robust CI/CD pipeline to revolutionize delivery of the MACH platform in an HVDC project. Join the GI MACH team to help build a next-generation data platform that unifies data from diverse sources, creating a single source of truth for code development, design, and manufacturing.

As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in automating and scaling the infrastructure that powers this platform, with extra focus on our internal applications and tools.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Design, develop, and implement mission-critical tools and applications to support a scalable, high-performance, high-volume production environment with global users.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for C++ and C# development environments, leveraging tools like Azure DevOps, MS Build scripts, Python and build systems.
Automate infrastructure and software processes using tools like Ansible or Terraform.
Manage containerized environments using Docker or Podman including creating and testing Windows and Linux images.
Implement full-stack monitoring and alerting systems using tools like Sensu, Splunk, Logstash or Nagios.
Plan and execute software and infrastructure upgrades based on data-driven capacity planning.
Manage configuration, variants, and version control using Git, TFVC, and release management tools like Jira.
Streamline development experiences for teams by designing scalable CI/CD processes and optimizing workflows with containerization and virtualization.
Collaborate with teams to support business needs and provide domain expertise for internal systems.

Your background

Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Expert skills in Linux, networking, storage, and virtualization.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python. Shell and Golang beneficial.
Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and experience designing pipelines using GitHub or GitLab.
Familiarity with build systems (Makefiles, CMake) or Bazel and release management tools (e.g.: Git).
Ability to manage software and infrastructure upgrades with a focus on scalability and performance.
Experience setting up and supporting development environments for C++ and C#. Embedded system developer background beneficial.
Strong English communication skills, Swedish is advantage.

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Arbeta praktiskt med testning som en del av teamets leveranser
Arbeta med API:er och integrationer
Felsöka och lösa problem i befintliga lösningar

Utöver det ovan ansvarar du även för att:

Driva egna utvecklings- och testuppgifter framåt
Delta i code reviews och teamets gemensamma utvecklingsarbete
Bidra i ett agilt arbetssätt med sprintar, daily standups och CI/CD
Bygga upp kunskap om den tekniska miljön och de verktyg som används i teamet

Rollen är baserad i Malmö. Teamet består av cirka 5-6 kollegor som arbetar nära varandra och hjälps åt genom att diskutera lösningar, dela kunskap och stötta varandra i vardagen.

Det som kännetecknar rollen är kombinationen av utveckling och test. Du arbetar med båda delarna i praktiken och får möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett brett tekniskt område samtidigt som du tar ett större eget ansvar över tid.

Vad vi söker hos dig ✨

För oss är det viktigare vad du har arbetat med och kan idag än exakt hur många år du har varit i branschen.

Som person tycker du om att förstå hur saker fungerar och tar ansvar för att få dina uppgifter framåt. Du försöker hitta lösningar på problem, men är också bekväm med att be om hjälp eller diskutera olika alternativ tillsammans med kollegor när det behövs.

Du trivs i en miljö där människor samarbetar, delar kunskap och hjälper varandra framåt.

Praktisk erfarenhet av Java

Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Kafka eller Spark

Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".

Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.

Det är du som arbetar nära kunden som vet vad dem behöver och vad som blir den bästa lösningen för just deras unika behov, både i dag och i morgon. Därför tycker vi att det är du som ska fatta besluten. Det är genom att erbjuda säkra, hållbara och kundanpassade lösningar som vi skapar värde för kunderna och samhället i stort.

Vi bryr oss om hur våra medarbetare mår – på riktigt. Därför samarbetar Advania med Ljung & Sjöberg för att skapa en trygg, proaktiv arbetsmiljö med stöd kring alkohol-, drog- och beroenderelaterade frågor. Tillsammans bygger vi en hållbar arbetsplats där det är okej att be om hjälp, och där förebyggande arbete gör skillnad – för individen, teamet och företaget.

I en miljö präglad av stort kundfokus och frihet under ansvar blir det extra viktigt för oss att bygga starka team bestående av ödmjuka stjärnor. Att arbeta i en inkluderande miljö, med kollegor och kunder som vill utvecklas, ger oss möjligheten att trivas och ha riktigt roligt på jobbet. Vi tror på en platt organisation med agilt arbetssätt och flexibilitet. Detta är det enda sättet för en hållbar framtid.

Advania Sverige, ”The tech company with people at heart”, har kontor över hela landet, från Luleå i norr till Malmö i syd. Dagligen hjälper våra 1 700 specialister våra kunder, både inom privat och offentlig sektor, i deras ambitioner och mål att digitalisera sina verksamheter. Genom långsiktiga relationer, ledande teknologier, moderna plattformslösningar och strategiska partnerskap formar vi framtidens IT-landskap. Vårt syfte sträcker sig bortom teknik: att ge människor kraften att skapa hållbara värden.

Advaniagruppen levererar tjänster till kunder i Sverige, Norge, Storbritannien, Island, Finland och Danmark inom hållbar och säker digitalisering.

GM’s Motorsports Software team analyzes, defines, and delivers next-generation, groundbreaking Motorsports IT software solutions. Using innovative cloud-based infrastructure and modern software development standards, these solutions enable seamless interaction between GM Global Engineering, GM Motorsports, and our race teams—helping accelerate our drivers to the finish line first.

In this role, you will lead and contribute to the delivery of complex software projects, developing applications using a variety of tools, languages, frameworks, and technologies. Excellent technical knowledge of C#/.NET and React

Proven track record of maintaining and debugging live software systems in production
