jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Database Migration Service
jobs.description:
Description

Database Migration for Amazon RDS is fully managed, serverless capability that enables customers to migrate SQL Server/Oracle workloads - whether running on Amazon RDS, Amazon EC2, on-premises infrastructure, or other cloud providers - to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Customers simply provide source and target connection details, and the service orchestrates the entire migration lifecycle end-to-end: pre-migration assessment, schema conversion, data movement.

In addition to a traditional console-driven experience, the service introduces an agentic migration workflow. Customers can initiate and manage migrations through natural language within the developer tools they already use - such as Kiro, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. The AI agent assesses the source environment, converts the schema, moves the data, validates the outcome - removing friction and reducing the expertise required to complete complex database migrations.

Amazon RDS is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement scalable, serverless microservices that power the migration lifecycle - assessment, schema conversion, data movement;
Develop intelligent, agent-driven migration workflows that integrate with modern developer tools and leverage natural language interfaces;
Own the end-to-end migration lifecycle - from pre-migration assessment and schema conversion through data movement phases;
Solve hard distributed systems challenges around reliability, security, and performance for customers migrating their most critical production workloads;
Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and AI/ML to deliver a seamless, low-friction migration experience that removes traditional barriers to database modernization;
Mentor SDE Is through code reviews, design guidance, and pair programming;
Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence initiatives.

A day in the life

You might start the day with participating in a design review for a new feature: parallel data movement for multi-terabyte databases. You whiteboard trade-offs between consistency guarantees and throughput, debating how to minimize downtime during cutover windows. Later, you pair with a teammate to debug a race condition in the serverless orchestration layer that surfaces only under high concurrency.

About The Team

You'll join a team of curious, driven engineers who believe that technical excellence and world-class reliability are not aspirations - they are the baseline our customers deserve. If you want to build something that matters, alongside people who challenge and inspire you, this is the place.

This is a rare opportunity to design and operate systems at true cloud scale while developing deep expertise across three of the most transformative domains in modern engineering: cloud computing, database technologies, and artificial intelligence.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
Experience in professional, non-internship software development
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Experience in development in the last 3 years

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

PM Group is looking for a Test Automation Engineer to join our team. We are seeking a Test Automation Engineer with proven experience working in a GMP-regulated environment to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for computerized systems supporting GxP operations. The role partners with software engineering, QA, validation, and business owners to build sustainable automation that accelerates release cycles while preserving full regulatory compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and GAMP 5 expectations

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and integration) for GxP applications including MES, LIMS, ERP, QMS, and laboratory/manufacturing systems.
Author and execute test scripts within a validated test management ecosystem (e.g., Robot Framework, Tricentis Tosca, TestComplete, Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, UFT) integrated with test management tools (Xray for Jira, Azure DevOps Test Plans, Polarion, Jenkins pipelines).
Produce GxP-compliant test documentation: test plans, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, test scripts, traceability matrices, defect reports, and summary reports — aligned to GAMP 5 risk-based testing.
Support Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) activities, including requirements traceability, risk assessment, and electronic records / electronic signatures (ERES) controls per 21 CFR Part 11.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab) with appropriate change-control gates so automation is itself qualified and version-controlled.
Partner with developers, business analysts, and validation engineers to shift testing left, define acceptance criteria as Gherkin scenarios (Given/When/Then), and ensure data integrity (ALCOA+) is preserved across test environments.
Investigate test failures, perform root-cause analysis, log deviations where required, and support CAPA activities related to test escapes and validation findings.
Maintain test environments, test data (including masked/synthetic GxP data), and reusable automation libraries; champion code reviews and framework standards.
Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA) by presenting automation strategy, evidence, and validation artifacts.

Job Overview

As a .NET Developer (Support) at Spanish Point Technologies, you will be an integral part of one of our support team, supporting a modern web application using the latest Microsoft platforms and technologies. You will be responsible for supporting solutions for our clients that leverage technologies like .NET Core, React, C#, .NET Framework, Azure, Azure DevOps, SQL Server, Azure Databricks with Python, Office365 and Dynamics365. This role will challenge your existing development skills and provide opportunities to expand your expertise in various Microsoft technologies. You will also gain exposure to all aspects of the solution delivery process, including business analysis, development and user training.
You will also play a key role in the roll-out of our innovative Matching Engine product at an exciting time in its maturity as the global standard product in music copyrighting.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Build reliable software with an international product team

Do you enjoy working across backend and frontend development, solving technical challenges and turning business needs into secure, reliable software?

As a Full-Stack Developer at Atea, you will develop and improve business-critical applications using C#/.NET, React and TypeScript. You will join an international product team and work closely with developers, Product Owners and other stakeholders across several European locations.

You will have meaningful technical responsibility, but you will not be expected to solve everything alone. You will have skilled colleagues around you who share knowledge, challenge ideas and work together to build software that creates real value for its users.

About The Role

You will contribute to products within the team’s portfolio, currently including solutions such as Zoom and Cloud Reports. The product scope may develop over time and could also include Application Manager Online.

Regardless of the product you work on, you will be part of the same international team and technical environment. You will contribute throughout the development process, from understanding requirements and discussing technical solutions to development, testing and continuous improvement.

The team works according to Agile principles, with security, maintainability and business value as important parts of the development process.

AI-assisted development is also part of how we work. We are looking for someone who can use AI tools thoughtfully and effectively while maintaining good engineering judgment and high standards for security and quality.

What You Will Do

In this role, you will:

Develop and maintain full-stack features using C#/.NET, APIs, React, TypeScript and JavaScript, based on product and business requirements.
Contribute to architecture and engineering quality by applying secure development principles, established design patterns and SOLID practices, as well as conducting code reviews and writing maintainable unit tests.
Improve the performance, availability and maintainability of our applications through troubleshooting, technical analysis and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with Product Owners, developers and stakeholders across locations, share knowledge within the team and use AI-assisted workflows to support development, testing and problem-solving.

Who We Think Will Thrive In This Role

You will probably enjoy this role if you like combining hands-on development with technical problem-solving and collaboration.

You take responsibility for your work and communicate clearly when requirements, priorities or technical decisions need to be discussed. You care about building solutions that are secure, stable and maintainable, while remaining curious about new technologies and better ways of working.

Because the team is distributed across several countries, you should be comfortable collaborating digitally and communicating with colleagues from different professional and cultural backgrounds.

What We Believe You Need From Day One

We believe the following experience is important for succeeding in the role:

At least four years of professional software development experience
Strong experience with C# and .NET, including API development
Practical experience with React, TypeScript and JavaScript
Experience working with Microsoft SQL databases
Experience with unit testing and writing maintainable tests
A good understanding of secure software development and SOLID principles
Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken, at approximately B2 level or above

Relevant professional experience may compensate for formal IT education.

It is an advantage if you also have

It would be useful, but not essential, if you have experience with:

Microsoft Azure, including Function Apps, Storage, App Service or Key Vault
Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
Cloud cost awareness and Azure cost optimisation
Mentoring or supporting other developers
Agile product development in an international or distributed team

What You Can Learn After Joining

You do not need to know every product, internal tool or Azure service from your first day.

You will have the opportunity to learn:

The products and business areas supported by the team
The team’s architecture, development processes and internal tools
Additional Azure services relevant to the product portfolio
How the team uses AI-assisted workflows in development, testing and problem-solving

Your curiosity, willingness to share knowledge and ability to learn are more important than being able to check every box.

What You Can Expect From Us

At Atea, you will join an international and welcoming working environment where collaboration and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

We offer:

A technically varied full-stack role across backend and frontend development
An international product team with skilled colleagues across several European locations
Opportunities to influence technical solutions, architecture and engineering practices
Training and development opportunities tailored to your professional goals
Access to company-sponsored certifications and relevant learning activities
A hybrid working model based on the role, location and business needs
An inclusive environment with professional and social meeting places
Local employment benefits based on whether you are employed in Norway or Latvia

We believe strong software is built by people who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other improve. You will receive responsibility and room to contribute, with a team around you when the problems become difficult.

A Little About Atea

Atea works with technology that supports organisations and the people who depend on it. Behind every reliable solution are people who develop, test, improve and support it together.

As part of Atea, you will join a wider professional community with opportunities to learn, share experience and develop your skills. We believe in giving people responsibility while making sure they have colleagues and expertise around them.

Practical information

Position type: Full-time
Location: Drammen, Norway or Riga, Latvia
Working model: Hybrid
Working language: Norwegian and English
Application deadline: 18.10.26
Contact person: Margarita Scerbakova
Job role: Developer

Interested?

If you would like to build secure and reliable software with an international team, we would be happy to hear from you.

You may not meet every preferred qualification listed above, and that is okay. If you have strong experience with the core technology stack, enjoy collaborative product development and are motivated to learn, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Vi søker en erfaren dataingeniør som vil bygge og drifte dataplattformen bak Placepoint. Du henter inn, modellerer og leverer eiendoms-, selskaps- og kartdata fra Norge og Sverige, sammen med oss to som gjør det i dag, og du bruker AI som et fast verktøy i jobben.

Om oss

Placepoint samler eiendomsinformasjon, eierskap, regulering, transaksjoner og kartdata i én plattform for Norge og Sverige. Over 850 kunder bruker oss, blant dem eiendomsbesittere, utviklere, banker, forsikringsselskaper, meglere og advokater. Vi er over 70 ansatte og holder til i Oslo sentrum.

Dataene er kjernen i det vi leverer. Vi henter dem fra offentlige registre som Matrikkelen, Grunnboken og Enhetsregisteret, fra svenske kilder som Lantmäteriet og Bolagsverket, og fra over 2 300 kartlag. Kundene bruker dem i Placepoint Fusion, Placepoint API og gjennom våre MCP-servere som lar AI-assistenter slå opp i dataene direkte.

Slik jobber vi

AI er en del av hvordan vi utvikler. Hvert repo har instruksjoner for Claude Code og Cursor, mye av koden skrives sammen med en AI-agent, og vi bygger egne MCP-servere så kunder og kolleger kan bruke dataene våre fra Claude og andre assistenter. Vi forventer at du bruker AI mye, og at du er med på å finne ut hvordan vi kan bruke det bedre.

Vi er et lite datateam med bredt ansvar. Den som bygger et dataløp, drifter det også, og vi rydder opp i årsaken når noe feiler.

Dette skal du jobbe med

Utvikle og optimalisere databasene våre i SQL Server og PostGIS: lagrede prosedyrer, datamodeller, indekser, partisjonering og ytelse på store tabeller.
Bygge og drifte dataløp som henter registerdata hver natt og hver uke, med Azure Data Factory, Python-jobber i Azure og dbt.
Følge med på at kjøringene går, finne feilen når de ikke gjør det, og gjøre dem robuste nok til at det skjer sjeldnere.
Modellere og koble norske og svenske registre: eiendom, bygg, adresser, selskaper, roller, eierskap og transaksjoner.
Videreutvikle Placepoint API, MCP-serverne våre og søkeindeksene i Azure AI Search.
Ta inn nye kartlag og datakilder, og holde dem oppdatert.
Levere datasett til kunder og hjelpe kolleger i produkt og salg med data og analyser.

Vi ser etter deg som

har minst seks års relevant arbeidserfaring
har høyere utdanning innen informatikk, geomatikk, matematikk eller lignende, eller tilsvarende arbeidserfaring
er svært god på SQL Server eller PostgreSQL: du skriver effektiv SQL, leser spørringsplaner, lager indekser som holder og modellerer data som skal leve lenge
har bygget og driftet dataløp i produksjon, med Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt eller tilsvarende
programmerer godt i Python eller C#, gjerne begge
bruker Claude, Cursor eller lignende AI-verktøy mye i hverdagen, eller er motivert for å gjøre det
snakker og skriver norsk flytende

Det er et pluss om du har erfaring med

PostGIS og geodata: geometri, koordinatsystemer som EUREF89 UTM, GeoJSON, GeoParquet og vektorfliser
norske registre og kartdata: Enhetsregisteret, Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Aksjonærregisteret og FKB fra Kartverket
svenske registre og data: Lantmäteriet, Bolagsverket og SCB
API-design, MCP-servere og søkemotorer som Azure AI Search eller Elasticsearch
Azure: Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault og Data Lake
Go
3D-data og bygningsmodeller
eiendomsbransjen eller finans

Ingen har alt dette. Vi jobber bredt, og du lærer nye verktøy mens du bruker dem. Det som veier tyngst, er at du lærer fort, bruker AI godt og bryr deg om at dataene er riktige.

Om deg

Du legger merke til når tall ikke stemmer, og graver til du finner årsaken.
Du tar ansvar for det du lager, også etter at det er i drift.
Du jobber selvstendig, deler det du finner og ber om hjelp når det sparer tid.
Du kan forklare et datasett og begrensningene i det til en kollega som ikke er utvikler.
Du trives med å jobbe på kontoret sammen med teamet.

jobs.title: Senior Developer (teknisen arkkitehdin urapolku), Power Platform & Dynamics 365
jobs.description:
Oletko kokenut ohjelmistokehittäjä, joka on huomannut käyttävänsä yhä enemmän aikaa teknisten ratkaisujen suunnitteluun, arkkitehtuurin hahmottamiseen tai muiden kehittäjien sparraamiseen?

Haemme
Digian Customer Applications & Power Platform (CA&PP) -yksikköön osaajaa, joka haluaa ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallaan kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia. Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis arkkitehti, mutta toivomme, että sinulla on jo kokemusta teknisistä päätöksistä, ratkaisujen suunnittelusta sekä kokonaisuuksien hahmottamisesta.

CA&PP-yksikössämme työskentelee yli 80 Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -osaajaa. Meitä yhdistää vahva asiantuntijuus, auttamisen kulttuuri sekä halu rakentaa asiakkaille aidosti lisäarvoa tuottavia ratkaisuja.

Työskentelemme hybridimallilla ja se tarkoittaa meille sitä, että digialaisilla on vapaus valita työskentelypaikkansa viitenä päivänä viikossa työn ja työyhteisön tarpeet huomioiden.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön kehitystyö ja kasvava vastuu teknisestä suunnittelusta.

Pääset esimerkiksi:

suunnittelemaan Power Platform- ja Dynamics 365 -ratkaisujen teknisiä toteutuksia
osallistumaan arkkitehtuurien, integraatioiden ja ratkaisukokonaisuuksien mallintamiseen
Rakentamaan tekoälyratkaisuja asiakkaille
sparraamaan kehittäjiä teknisissä ratkaisuissa
tekemään edelleen hands-on-kehitystä osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan
osallistumaan asiakaskeskusteluihin ja teknisten vaihtoehtojen arviointiin
vaikuttamaan siihen, miten ratkaisuja rakennetaan nyt ja tulevaisuudessa
seuraamaan Microsoft-ekosysteemin kehitystä ja tuomaan uusia mahdollisuuksia osaksi asiakasratkaisuja

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla pitkäaikaista kokemusta arkkitehtina. Sen sijaan arvostamme kokemusta ja kiinnostusta tekniseen suunnitteluun.

Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta ainakin osasta seuraavista:

Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Dynamics 365 -ratkaisuista
JavaScriptista ja/tai C#:sta (esimerkiksi pluginit)
integraatioista ja Azure-palveluista
DevOps- ja ALM-käytännöistä
teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, dokumentoinnista tai arkkitehtuurikuvausten laatimisesta
tekoälytyökalujen hyödyntämisestä omassa työssä
muiden kehittäjien tukemisesta tai teknisestä ohjaamisesta

Työssä tarvitset hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Tämä rooli sopii erinomaisesti sinulle, joka haluat kasvaa kohti teknistä arkkitehtuuria kokeneiden ammattilaisten ympäröimänä.

Tarjoamme:

mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa polkuasi senior developerista kohti teknistä arkkitehtiroolia.
Oppimista tukevan kulttuurin. Sinulle varataan viikoittain aikaa uuden oppimisen ja teknologioihin syventymiseen eli työarjessasi on väljyyttä.
Mentorointia ja tukea kokeneilta arkkitehdeilta ja kehittäjiltä. Myös toimitustiimien ja heimojen kautta osaamista jaetaan työajalla.
Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa roolisi sisältöön ja urapolkuusi.
Erinomaiset työsuhde-edut, kuten kattavat työterveyspalvelut, loma-ajan mökit, 2000 euron rekrytointibonuksen jne.
OpenClub-yhteisöt: leffat, padel, käsityöt, lautapelit, kahvihifistely, viinit, uinti… löydät varmasti omasi!

Räätälöimme lopullisen roolin osaamisesi, kokemuksesi ja uratoiveidesi mukaan.

Hakuaika päättyy 11.10.2026.
Jos sinulle heräsi kysyttävää Digiasta tai tehtävästä, voit olla yhteydessä tiiminvetäjiimme Minna Arramieheen, minna.arramies@digia.com tai Terhi Mäkitaloon terhi.makitalo@digia.com.

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description:
Department

IT & Automation, Drug Substance Manufacturing, Global Manufacturing & Supply

Location

Kalundborg, Denmark. Your main base is close to the manufacturing sites. Travel to partner locations in the Copenhagen area may occur on an ad hoc basis but is not a regular work location.

Your impact begins here

As a Computerized Systems Engineer, you keep the computerized equipment, smart instruments and IT/OT systems behind large-scale drug substance production running reliably and in a validated, GMP-compliant state. Your work supports consistent, stable operations that colleagues in production depend on every day—helping ensure the medicines people living with serious chronic diseases rely on can be made safely and on time.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a proactive, collaborative colleague who is eager to develop within computerized systems, digital manufacturing and IT/OT support in a GMP-regulated environment.

Essential

A B.Sc., M.Sc., AP Degree or similar within IT, Engineering, Automation, Instrumentation, Computer Science or a related technical field.
Full professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.
An interest in learning GMP requirements and maintaining systems in a validated environment.
A structured, solution-oriented approach, ownership of your tasks and genuine enjoyment of working with different stakeholders.

Useful, But Not Essential

Experience from IT, automation, instrumentation, manufacturing support, laboratory systems or technical support functions. Recent graduates with relevant internships, student jobs or project work are also encouraged to apply.
Knowledge of manufacturing processes or experience from a regulated industry.
Experience with incident and change management, user administration, system maintenance, SOPs, backup and recovery, or supplier coordination.
Familiarity with validation, data integrity, IT security, risk assessments, infrastructure or computerized systems lifecycle management.

What You'll Do

You'll help secure reliable, compliant operations across production by maintaining the systems that keep manufacturing moving. In practice, you will:

Maintain and support computerized equipment, smart instruments and related IT components to ensure availability, reliability and operational stability.
Contribute to ongoing process validation (OPV) and periodic reviews, and manage Operation and Maintenance SOPs through their full lifecycle.
Support incident, problem, deviation and change management, and coordinate patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, restore planning and user access in line with quality and validation requirements.
Identify IT and computerized equipment risks and complete IT risk assessments covering security, data integrity, infrastructure, coding/configuration, smart instruments and operational support.
Safeguard data integrity for electronic data generated, processed, stored or transferred by computerized equipment and smart instruments.

Who You'll Work With

You'll join the IT & Automation Department—a diverse team of colleagues from many nationalities and professional backgrounds. The atmosphere is inclusive and collaborative: people support each other in finding answers and share the load across tasks. Because project life moves fast, the team is dynamic and ready to shift priorities to hit important milestones.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across manufacturing, quality and validation in Kalundborg, and with collaboration partners based around Copenhagen. Together, you'll keep the project running with clarity and speed.

What You Can Expect Here

You'll work in one of the strongest IT and Automation environments in the pharmaceutical industry, with real scope to build new skills across computerized systems, digital manufacturing and GMP-regulated IT/OT support. Whether you're an experienced engineer or a recent graduate, you'll be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to make your voice heard and supported to grow.

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the annual base salary ranges from DKK 499,600 to DKK 734,400 corresponding to the level of the position. The role is open to candidates with varying levels of experience, and placement within the range is assessed during recruitment based on your skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you're ready to keep large-scale drug substance production running reliably and compliantly, apply for the Computerized Systems Engineer role by 23 September 2026.

For further information about the position, please contact Tinne Bonde at THEB@novonordisk.com

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

jobs.description:
Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.
Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.
Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.
Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.
Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.
Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

You’re a great match if

You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team
You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off
You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them
You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team
You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

Nice to have

Experience working on live games

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture
You value a positive work environment
You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

Practicalities

Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen
Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role
37-hour work week, with flexible work hours
No crunch, we put people before deadlines
Our working language is English

We offer

Silly but ambitious projects
The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games
A professional development budget to invest in your growth
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
Six weeks of paid vacation
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked
Pension plan and private health insurance
Endless amounts of coffee

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

Job Summary

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Aspen MES Programmer with 15+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting AspenTech Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions in regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. This is a senior technical and advisory role for an individual who has led complex MES implementations end-to-end, mentored junior engineers, and served as the go-to subject matter expert for Aspen MES architecture, integration, and validation strategy. The successful candidate will combine deep technical mastery of Aspen InfoPlus.21 and the AspenTech MES/MOM suite with strong leadership skills, acting as a technical lead on multi-site programs, greenfield implementations, and enterprise-level system upgrades, while ensuring full compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and data integrity requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Serve as the senior technical authority and architect for Aspen MES / Aspen InfoPlus.21 (IP.21) solutions across one or more manufacturing sites, defining system architecture, standards, and best practices.
Lead the design and configuration of complex electronic batch records (EBRs), recipe management structures, equipment models, and unit procedures for high-complexity or multi-product manufacturing lines.
Own the technical roadmap for MES platform evolution, including upgrade strategy, capacity planning, and long-term architecture decisions across the Aspen MOM/MES suite (Aspen MES, Aspen PEM, Aspen Enterprise Historian).
Evaluate emerging AspenTech capabilities and industry trends (Industry 4.0, MES/MOM convergence, cloud-enabled historians) and advise leadership on adoption strategy.

Development, Integration & Delivery

Lead full lifecycle delivery of large-scale MES projects: requirements definition, functional/technical design, configuration, custom scripting, integration, testing, validation, and go-live support.
Architect and oversee complex integrations between Aspen MES and DCS/SCADA/PLC systems (e.g., DeltaV, PCS7), ERP platforms (SAP, including SAP MII/PI-PO), LIMS, warehouse management, and serialization/track-and-trace systems.
Design and review advanced scripts, calculations, and custom reports using Aspen MES scripting tools, SQL, and supporting languages (VB.NET, C#, Python) to extend platform capability.
Direct and review the work of junior and mid-level MES programmers/engineers, providing technical mentorship, code/configuration review, and knowledge transfer.
Lead root-cause analysis and resolution for the most complex, cross-system production issues and data integrity discrepancies, minimizing manufacturing downtime.

Quality, Compliance & Validation

Own and drive computer system validation (CSV) strategy for MES projects in accordance with GAMP 5, authoring and approving URS, FS, DS, and IQ/OQ/PQ documentation.
Ensure all MES architecture, configuration, and development activities comply with 21 CFR Part 11, GMP, and data integrity (ALCOA+) principles.
Serve as the senior MES representative in audits, regulatory inspections, and internal quality reviews, providing technical justification and remediation plans as needed.
Lead change control activities for significant MES configuration changes, including impact assessments, risk analysis, and cross-functional approval coordination.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

Partner with Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Automation/OT, IT, and Validation leadership to support new product introductions, technology transfers, and site expansions.
Act as primary technical liaison with AspenTech (or implementation partners) for escalations, licensing, upgrade planning, and roadmap alignment.
Present technical strategies, risk assessments, and project status to senior management and stakeholders.
Develop and deliver advanced training programs for engineering staff, operators, and quality personnel on MES functionality and best practices.

Required Qualifications

15+ years of progressive, hands-on experience developing, architecting, and supporting AspenTech MES (Aspen MES / Aspen InfoPlus.21 / Aspen Production Execution Manager) within regulated pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences manufacturing environments.
Demonstrated experience leading full-cycle MES implementations, including greenfield deployments and multi-site rollouts.
Deep expertise in electronic batch record (EBR) design, recipe/procedure modeling, and complex production workflow configuration.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle) for data architecture, reporting, and troubleshooting.
Strong working knowledge of automation/control systems (PLC, SCADA, DCS) and OT/IT integration architecture.
Expert-level understanding of GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and computer system validation (CSV) methodology, with a track record of leading validation efforts.
Proven experience managing change control, deviation investigations, and CAPA related to MES systems.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and lead technical teams, and to communicate effectively with senior leadership, quality, and regulatory stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills for complex, multi-system, business-critical issues.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Aspen Production Execution Manager (PEM), Aspen Enterprise Historian, or the broader AspenTech Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) suite.
Experience architecting MES-to-ERP integrations (SAP MII, PI/PO, or equivalent middleware) at an enterprise scale.
Advanced scripting/programming experience in VB.NET, C#, or Python for platform extension and automation.
Experience in sterile/aseptic processing, biologics, solid dose, or combination product manufacturing.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 / ISA-88 standards and their application in enterprise MES architecture.
Experience leading serialization/track-and-trace integration initiatives.
ISPE / GAMP certification, PMP, or equivalent professional certification.
Prior experience in a technical lead, principal engineer, or MES architect role.

Design and implement workflow‑based control automation for Regulatory Standards (e.g., ISO, PCI) and SOX 404 ITGCs, using:
Explicit start–action–evidence–end flows.
Triggers from tickets, change‑management systems, HR events, or IAM changes.
Delivered via tools such as n8n, Camunda, Azure Logic Apps, or custom MCP‑style servers.

Build and operate MCP‑style or MCP‑compatible servers that expose:
Tools: RESTful endpoints for “trigger evidence collection”, “run access review”, “validate change ticket”, etc..
Resources: Standardized data sources (logs, IAM, ticket data) formatted for AI agents or workflow engines.
Auth patterns: API keys, bearer tokens, OAuth2, or OIDC‑style flows that can be consumed by agents or external tools.

Write scripts and connectors (Python, Node.js, Bash, etc.) that call, compose, and orchestrate APIs from:
IAM, IdP, PAM, HRIS, ticketing, cloud IAM, and logging platforms, etc.
GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, 6clicks, or similar) via REST APIs.

Authentication and authorization (API keys, Bearer, OAuth2, JWT, Basic, MTLS).
Pagination, retry with backoff, rate‑limiting, and safe error handling.
Idempotency and safe state transitions for audit‑critical operations.

Translate ISO 27001 controls and SOX 404 ITGCs into automated workflows:
Example pattern:
Trigger: new user join or role change in IAM.
Action: call APIs to validate entitlements, cross‑check against SoD, and emit evidence to a GRC tool.
Outcome: workflow‑generated record for ISO 27001 access control and SOX logical‑access control.

Maintain one source of truth for control logic (code / config) and use workflow IDs as control‑evidence bindings.

Design AI‑agent‑ready interfaces:
Expose structured, MCP‑style endpoints or OpenAPI specs so that LLM agents or workflow tools can call concrete tools (e.g., “get latest access review for System X”, “run change‑ticket‑completeness check”).
Handle dynamic policy enforcement: short‑lived tokens, context‑aware access, and audit logging for each AI or agent call.

Integrate with data platforms and SIEM/logging:
Use logs, change tickets, and identity events as workflow inputs.
Build automated tests for control effectiveness (e.g., “if a production change is not approved, fire an alert and record as control failure”) linked to ISO / SOX control IDs.

Maintain audit‑ready workflow artifacts:
Log all workflow steps, including timestamps, input, user/agent context, and outputs.
Ensure workflow outputs are machinable (JSON, structured logs) and can be replayed or reasoned over by auditors or AI agents.

Requirements

Students currently pursuing Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or related disciplines.
Strong understanding of authorization and authentication:
API keys, Bearer tokens, OAuth2 (client, JWT, PKCE), Basic Auth, MTLS, and OIDC‑style flows.

Deep practical experience with:

GRC platforms via APIs (e.g., ServiceNow, 6clicks, or similar).

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

AI agents are non-deterministic: the same input can produce different outputs across runs. Designing enterprise automation around them takes a different discipline than deterministic RPA; grounded context, dynamic decision logic, and guardrails instead of fixed, scripted paths.

This is a forward-deployed, customer-facing engineering role. You will work side by side with enterprise and public sector customers to design, build, and harden agentic workflows in their live environments; combining the hands-on coding of a software engineer, the platform depth of a UiPath specialist, and the end-to-end perspective of a solution architect. You will own the question every customer asks before putting an AI agent into production: “How do we know we can trust it?”

What You'll Do At UiPath

Own the end-to-end architecture for UiPath automation and agentic programs at customer sites - agents, RPA workflows, integrations, data, and human-in-the-loop steps - and document the trade-offs behind it.
Design agentic workflows that combine LLM decision-making with tool and function calling, context grounding, and deterministic fallbacks, so behaviour stays predictable where the business needs it to be.
Architect Document Understanding pipelines - extraction, classification, validation - and the Python services that connect them to customer systems.
Choose the right GenAI/ML technique per problem; prompting, retrieval and context grounding, or a trained model in AI Center; and set the guardrails, human checkpoints, and escalation paths before go-live.
Deploy and operationalize AI agents in production customer environments, including APIs, data pipelines, and integration with existing systems.
Act as a trusted technical advisor: translate requirements into architecture and explain design choices, risks, and trade-offs to audiences from engineers to executives.
Set the standards, reusable patterns, and design reviews that govern delivery from discovery to hypercare; mentor developers and keep the architecture something customers can operate themselves.
Feed field findings such as failure patterns, missing capabilities, design gaps; back into the product roadmap and into reusable assets and accelerators.

What You'll Bring To The Team

7+ years of hands-on software development in Python, C#, TypeScript, VB.NET, or comparable languages, with production-quality code and solid CS fundamentals.
4+ years building UiPath automation workflows, with working knowledge of Orchestrator, Document Understanding, Action Apps, AI Center, and Insights.
Command of UiPath design patterns - Robotic Enterprise Framework, Document Understanding Framework, orchestration processes - and the judgment to know when each fits.
Hands-on experience building, deploying, or operating LLM-based agents and agentic workflows (tool/function calling, RAG, multi-step orchestration, LangChain/LangGraph, Model Context Protocol), ideally in production.
Working understanding of prompting, grounding, and hallucination - and the judgment to keep agent behaviour inside acceptable bounds once it is live.
Proven customer-facing track record in a forward-deployed, professional services, implementation, or consulting role: leading technical workshops, managing stakeholders, delivering under real-world constraints.
Technical leadership across globally distributed teams - driving strategy, mentoring engineers, establishing best practices.
Experience designing end-to-end solutions across applications, APIs, and automation platforms, with a deep grasp of the design choices that make a system scalable, reliable, and fast.
Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to present complex architecture and delivery risk to executive stakeholders.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across every channel. Behind these capabilities are engineering teams that must understand both the platform’s architecture and the regulated, complex environments where customers operate.

The FDE role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You will be embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA customers — working directly with their teams to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build what’s needed to unblock adoption and expansion.

This is not a support role. You don’t wait for tickets. You operate inside cross-functional Customer Pods — small, autonomous teams with end-to-end ownership — translating customer problems into working platform solutions. You lead with architecture, prototype rapidly, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers.

What You’ll Do

Partner directly with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives
Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes
Investigate and troubleshoot production-level platform issues — from data ingestion and identity resolution to journey orchestration and audience activation
Design and validate end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and adjacent Adobe systems
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that earn customer trust before any commercial motion
Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate on new capabilities — using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of execution
Bridge the gap between customer needs, product direction, and engineering implementation — feeding field patterns back into the product roadmap
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts — from initial discovery through implementation, go-live, and expansion

What Succes Looks Like

We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates will show:

Customer-to-Solution Thinking — you connect customer problems, workflows, and business goals with practical technical solutions — collapsing the gap between requirement and working platform capability
Architecture with Execution — you don’t just design; you prototype, validate, debug, and iterate. Your architectures work because you’ve built them, not just drawn them
Production Awareness — you understand how distributed systems behave at scale — data integrity, graceful degradation, and observability are part of how you think, not afterthoughts
Enterprise Navigation — you operate across complex organizational boundaries, regulatory constraints, and multi-stakeholder environments with confidence and credibility
AI-Augmented Execution — you use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a standard part of how you design, prototype, and deliver
Adaptability Under Ambiguity — you navigate evolving environments where experimentation, learning, and iteration are core to the process — and you don’t mistake seniority for certainty

Typical background: 8–15+ years across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering roles. What matters is what that experience has produced — not the title or the number of years.

Your Domain

AEP / RTCDP / AJO: Adobe’s core platform — data ingestion, segmentation, journey orchestration, audience activation
Enterprise Architecture: Multi-system integration, data flows, identity resolution, API design across complex landscapes
Security & Compliance: Regulated industries (FSI, Healthcare), data sovereignty, privacy-preserving architectures, GDPR
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure — infrastructure patterns, managed services, networking
Data Platforms: Event-driven architectures, streaming pipelines, batch processing, data lakes
Observability: Platform health, SLO definition, performance governance, production monitoring

What We Value

Beyond technical execution, the people who grow fastest on this team demonstrate:

Agency - You identify problems before they are assigned to you and drive them to resolution
Product Judgment - You understand what the platform needs to do for customers, not just what the ticket says to build
Customer Empathy -You earn trust by understanding the customer’s world — their constraints, pressures, and what success looks like for them
Builder Mindset - You are as comfortable prototyping a new capability as you are presenting an architecture to a CT

Nice to Have
:

Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products (AEP, AJO, RTCDP, CJA, Target)
Experience with similar platforms - CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms
Background in regulated industries (Financial Services, Healthcare, Government) and familiarity with their compliance and security constraints
Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration patterns
Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification systems
Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar)
Track record of driving architecture decisions or technical strategy at team or org level

Why This Team

Work on complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact — your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks
Operate inside autonomous, cross-functional Pods embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA accounts
Combine architecture, strategy, engineering, and customer engagement in a single role — no two weeks look the same
Shape a new engineering engagement model centered around rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution
Collaborate with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams
Build engineering credibility that earns expansion rights — from workshops to FDE to renewals

About Adobe

Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

jobs.description:
Project Description: Product verification & testing for an L1-L3 Traffic Generator Solution for a Global Networking Testing and Validation equipment provider.

Our team: A team of networking enthusiasts willing to contribute to customer success.

Technologies used: Networking protocols, traffic generation tools, Windows/Linux servers, network virtualization, network management tools, microservices.

Opportunities: Networking and testing certifications, collaboration with an international team of professionals, working with the latest networking technologies and concepts, access to training.

Responsibilities

o Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.
o Derive automation requirements from manual functional test specifications and hardware validation reports
o Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
o Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
o Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
o Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
o Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
o Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
o Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
o Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
o Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
o Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.

Qualifications

o Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
o QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);
Python strongly preferred (other comparable languages considered).
o Automated Testing for API or CLI 4+ years, including experience in test harness or framework
development.
o Hands-on experience automating Spirent TestCenter (STC) using its Python API — specifically StcPython
native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability
to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics
retrieval.
o Familiarity with STC Lab Server architecture: connecting to chassis, managing test sessions, and
executing automated sequences without GUI dependency.
o Experience writing and maintaining long-running automation suites (soak tests of days/weeks duration)
with robust result collection, error handling, and reporting.
o Working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols exercised through STC: Ethernet, VLAN/QinQ, BGP (v4/v6),
OSPF (v2/v3), IS-IS, MPLS/LDP, BFD, and data-center protocols such as VXLAN and EVPN; ability to
configure emulated/simulated router topologies for scale and convergence testing.
o Familiarity with RFC 2544 / RFC 2889 benchmarking methodology for throughput, latency, frame loss and
back-to-back testing.
o Practical experience with AI tooling in day-to-day activities to improve productivity and delivery quality
(code generation, code review, automation, agentic AI, MCP usage, etc.).
o Experience in performance, scale, and convergence testing; ability to analyze and improve performance
and convergence at system level.
o Ability to develop and publish solution validation documents and test reports.
o Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across QA and
Development teams.
o Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to collaborate cross-functionally to meet challenging goals.

jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.
To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.
Software Developer
Role ID – NATOIS-0049 Role Background

NATO International Staff requires a Software Developer – Expert Consultant
to support the Defence Planning and Policy Division, Defence Planning Directorate, Data Analysis Section
.
The role focuses on developing and maintaining solutions for data collection, analysis and visualisation
, particularly web applications and dashboards supporting defence-planning data analysis.
Role Duties and Responsibilities

Design, develop and deploy web-based dashboards.
Develop and configure web applications using modern web frameworks.
Develop and test data-collection solutions.
Transform and integrate data from classified and unclassified sources into web-based systems.
Perform data conversion and preprocessing using Python APIs and ETL tools
.
Develop and improve data-collection tools based on stakeholder requirements.
Develop and maintain documentation for code, service endpoints and system architecture.
Support security testing and approval activities.
Test solutions with stakeholders and ensure requirements are met.
Develop data-driven dashboards for senior leadership using Python and/or Power BI
.
Support workshops and stakeholder engagements.
Provide knowledge transfer and training materials.
Report on progress and identify potential project/timeline risks.
Brief NATO International Staff and leadership on project progress.

Essential Skills

JavaScript and HTML.
Modern web development frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular
.
MS SQL

.
Python

for automation, ETL and data analysis.
Python libraries including pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib
.
Development of data-driven dashboards using Python and/or Power BI
.
Backend services and/or data-processing pipelines.
Data integration and preprocessing.
Git/version control.
Agile project management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable:

Practical .NET
experience

Experience

Minimum 5 years of web development experience
using JavaScript/HTML and frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular.
Extensive MS SQL experience.
Experience developing dashboards for senior stakeholders.
Strong Python experience for automation, ETL and analysis.
Experience building and maintaining backend services or processing pipelines.

educations and Certifications

Bachelor's Degree

in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field.
Advanced English.

Working Location

NATO HQ, Brussels, Belgium / Remote

The contractor has flexibility to work remotely combined with some physical presence at NATO HQ.
Working Policy

Hybrid / flexible remote working with some on-site presence in Brussels.

The contractor must be available for contact during approximately half of NATO's official working hours, taking time-zone differences into account.
Base period: 1 November – 31 December 2026

Base scope: 304 hours

Option 1: 2027 – 1,672 hours

Option 2: 1 January – 30 June 2028 – 836 hours

Travel to NATO HQ may occur 2–3 times during the performance period
, with travel costs included in the quoted price.
Signed NDA required.

Travel

Some travel to other NATO sites may be required

Valid National or NATO Secret personal security clearance

, een bedrijfswagen (of mogelijkheid tot mobiliteitsbudget!) en een totaalpakket aan extra-legale voordelen! Zaken zoals een FIP-plan
, een uitgebreid opleidingsbudget
, hybride werkbeleid
, netto-onkostenvergoeding, verzekeringen, gsm, -en internetabonnementen, … mogen natuurlijk niet ontbreken.

Heb jij het gevoel dat deze uitdaging voor jou weggelegd is? Aarzel dan niet om te solliciteren en dan ontmoeten we je hopelijk snel op een van onze kantoren in Gent of Antwerpen!

AANBOD PERMANENT

Innovatieve Klantprojecten

Persoonlijke en Professionele Ontwikkeling
: Ervaar groei door individuele coaching van technische experts, die je begeleiden op persoonlijk en professioneel vlak. Aangevuld met een individueel opleidingsbudget dat je kan inzetten voor opleidingen, conferenties in binnen- en buitenland en doorgedreven certificatie.
Cultuur van kennisdeling
: Je kan steeds deelnemen aan workshops en andere initiatieven georganiseerd door jouw collega's. Omgekeerd kan jij zowel binnen jouw team, als met experts uit onze verschillende IT-domeinen, impact maken door jouw kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de innovatie en groei van Axxes.
Feel Good @ Axxes
: Axxes is één van de Best Workplaces van België, gestuurd door de woorden 'IT is about People'. Op regelmatige basis komen we dan ook graag samen tijdens familie-events, maandelijkse drinks, hackathons, sportinitiatieven, employee initiatives (fiets- en wandelclub, quiz-nights, karting,…). Kortom, voor ieder wat wils!

Profiteer van een flexibel werkregime met thuiswerkdagen, afgestemd op de behoeften van jou en de klant, voor een optimale work-life balans.
Volledig geoptimaliseerd pakket:
We bieden een competitief salaris met keuze tussen een bedrijfswagen of mobiliteitsbudget, aangevuld met een heel scala aan extralegale voordelen.

.

Strong problem-solving, ownership and delivery focus
Ability to mentor and guide distributed onshore–offshore teams

Demonstrable hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI in production

Azure certifications (AI-102, AZ-204 or equivalent) preferred

Production-ready voice and conversational AI assistants deployed on Azure
Measurable improvement in containment, deflection, handling time and customer satisfaction

NATO International Staff - Defence Planning and Policy Division - Defence Planning Directorate - Data Analysis Section

The Defence Policy and Planning (DPP) Division has the lead role on the defence-related aspects of NATO's fundamental security tasks at the political-military level. Within DPP, the Defence Planning Directorate (DPD) has the lead in the International Staff (IS) for the coordinated execution of the NATO Defence Planning Process (NDPP) and in assisting the defence reform efforts of nations.

The Data Analysis Section provides support to DPD, the wider Division and HQ, in particular the Office of the Secretary General (OSG), in the provision of reports on Allies' defence spending. The Section works in close cooperation with national Delegations and staff in national capitals on all business related to the financial and data analysis aspects of defence planning, including the analysis of national defence financial programmes.

NATO POC for supervision and coordination purposes:
Head, Data Analysis Section

Objectives and scope of work:
The contractor will work closely with the analysts in the Data Analysis Section to provide support with the development and maintenance of various solutions for data collection, analysis and visualisation.

Develop and configure web applications using modern web development frameworks
Transform and integrate data coming from classified and unclassified sources into web-based systems
Perform data conversion and preprocessing, using Python APIs and ETL tools
Further develop data collection tooling, aligning with stakeholder requirements
Develop and maintain documentation for code, service endpoints, and system architecture, as well as training materials
Support security testing and approval activities
Test developed solutions with stakeholders and ensure solutions meet their requirements
Develop data-based dashboards for use by (senior) leadership using Python or PowerBI
Conduct close coordination with Lead Point of Contact, as well as regularly report on progress, and advise on project management and potential risk to the timeline of the project

Work to start on 1 November 2026. The contract will continue until the end of December 2026. Possibility of extension, pending performance and budget approval.

Travel:
Travel to NATO HQ may occur 2-3 times during performance period. Travel cost must be included in the quoted price.

The contracted individual must be in possession of an active and valid security clearance of NATO SECRET. A signed Non-Disclosure Agreement will be required.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or related fields
At least 5 years of experience in web development using JavaScript/HTML including frameworks such as React, Vue.js, Angular
Extensive experience with MS SQL
Practical experience with .NET is an asset
Experience developing data-driven dashboards for senior stakeholders using Python and/or PowerBI
Proficiency in using Python for automation, ETL and analysis (e.g. pandas, numpy, matplotlib)
Ability to build and maintain backend services or processing pipelines
Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
Excellent communication skills
Language requirements: English: Advanced;
Familiarity with version control (Git) and Agile project management
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
