jobs.title: Senior Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
Senior Cloud Architect

Contract One-year B2B contract

Location Brussels (EU fully remote or 50% onsite in Brussels)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Architect to join the Cloud System Team.
The Cloud System Team defines, engineers and continuously evolves the organisation's cloud capabilities, enabling secure, scalable and resilient cloud adoption across corporate, business-critical and highly critical operational workloads.
The cloud environment is primarily based on Microsoft Azure and follows a landing zone model aligned with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework. It uses Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, policy-driven governance and self-service consumption to provide standardized cloud capabilities to application teams.
The Senior Cloud Architect contributes to the design and evolution of cloud architectures, foundations and platform capabilities. The role supports cloud adoption, workload modernization and datacenter-to-cloud migration initiatives and provides architecture studies, solution designs and technical guidance. Working with Cloud Platform Engineering, Security, Cloud Run, Network, Enterprise Architecture and application teams, the architect helps ensure solutions are secure, resilient, supportable and aligned with approved architectural direction, including future multi-cloud capabilities.
Key Tasks and Responsibilities

The scope includes, but is not limited to:
Cloud Architecture and Solution Design
Contribute to the design and evolution of the Azure cloud platform, landing zones, and workload architectures.
Produce architecture studies, HLDs, technical assessments, reference patterns and option analyses for complex cloud initiatives.
Support workload onboarding, critical workload architecture, application modernization and datacenter-to-cloud migration initiatives.

Cloud Governance, Security and Standards
Contribute to cloud architecture principles, standards, governance requirements and policies.
Define architecture guidance for Zero Trust, identity, privileged access, network isolation, Private Link and Azure-native security capabilities.
Ensure alignment between business, security, compliance, operational and platform requirements.

Cloud Networking Architecture
Define architecture patterns for Virtual WAN, hub-and-spoke, ExpressRoute, VPN, routing, segmentation and hybrid connectivity.
Guide multi-region networking, Private Link, traffic inspection and third-party networking or SD-WAN integration.
Collaborate with Network and Platform Engineering teams to ensure designs are secure, implementable and operationally supportable.

Resilience and Operational Architecture
Define architecture patterns for highly available, zone-redundant, multi-region and highly critical workloads.
Define backup, disaster recovery, recoverability and operational continuity approaches aligned with availability, RTO and RPO requirements.
Ensure solutions are observable, supportable, maintainable and operationally viable in collaboration with Cloud Run and application teams.

Application and Platform Engineering Enablement
Guide application teams and projects on Azure service selection, architecture trade-offs, migration approaches and modernization options.
Work with Cloud Platform Engineers to translate approved architecture into reusable platform services and self-service capabilities.
Review designs, identify constraints and risks, and promote reuse, standardization and automation.

Technology Strategy and Innovation
Conduct technology evaluations, proofs of concept and architecture assessments for new Azure and cloud capabilities.
Contribute to cloud roadmaps, datacenter exit and cloud transformation initiatives and future multi-cloud scenarios.
Assess strategic options, technical debt, simplification opportunities and long-term platform evolution.

Collaboration, Documentation and Knowledge Sharing
Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering, Cloud Run, Security, Network, Enterprise Architecture and application teams.
Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops and technical decision-making within the established design authority.
Maintain HLDs, reference architectures, architecture decisions, design guidance and knowledge-sharing material.

Job Requirements

Technical Competencies and Experience
Proven expertise in designing and governing enterprise-scale cloud architectures and cloud operating models.
Extensive expertise in Microsoft Azure architecture, cloud adoption and landing zone design aligned with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.
Proven expertise producing HLDs, architecture studies, assessments, reference patterns and technical recommendations for complex cloud initiatives.
Proven architecture expertise in datacenter-to-cloud migrations, workload discovery and assessment, migration strategy, application modernization and transition planning.
Proven expertise designing architectures for business-critical and highly critical operational workloads with demanding security, availability, resilience and continuity requirements.
Strong expertise in cloud governance, policy-as-code, cloud security architecture, Zero Trust, Microsoft Entra ID and privileged access design.
Strong expertise in Azure networking architecture, including Virtual WAN, hub-and-spoke, ExpressRoute, VPN, routing, segmentation, hybrid connectivity, Private Link and traffic inspection.
Proven expertise designing highly available, zone-redundant, multi-region, backup and disaster-recovery architectures, including RTO and RPO considerations.
Strong understanding of Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, platform engineering, Azure DevOps and DevSecOps operating models.
Proven ability to assess technology and migration options, architecture trade-offs, implementation constraints, operational impacts and long-term platform evolution.
Excellent architecture documentation, workshop facilitation, stakeholder engagement and technical communication capabilities.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with Security, Platform Engineering, Network, Operations, Enterprise Architecture and application stakeholders.
Proven knowledge of AWS architecture and multi-cloud design principles is considered an advantage.

Level of Education

University degree of four years in a relevant domain, such as Computer Science or Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
Professional Certifications and Training
Required certification

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

Preferred certifications

Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert

Considered an advantage

AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Practitioner or equivalent

Cloud Platform Engineer

Contract One-year B2B contract

Location 50% onsite Brussels or fully remote EU

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Cloud Platform Engineer to join the Cloud System Team.
The Cloud System Team engineers, automates and continuously improves the organisation's cloud platform foundation, enabling secure, scalable and standardized cloud adoption across corporate, business-critical and highly critical operational workloads.
The cloud platform is primarily based on Microsoft Azure and follows a landing zone model aligned with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework. It relies heavily on Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, DevSecOps, policy-as-code, reusable platform services and self-service cloud consumption.
The Cloud Platform Engineer develops and maintains reusable Terraform modules, landing zone and subscription automation, governance controls, networking services, observability capabilities and security guardrails. The role translates approved architecture, security and operational requirements into reusable cloud platform services that application teams can consume consistently, securely and compliantly.
The role collaborates closely with Cloud Architects, Security teams, Cloud Run engineers and application teams. This includes hands-on application enablement where required and close cooperation with the Cloud Run Team on operational readiness, knowledge exchange, cross-skilling and potential rotation between engineering and run-support functions.
The organisation also operates dedicated cloud environments for highly critical operational workloads, requiring enhanced security, resilience and Zero Trust controls implemented through code and reusable platform capabilities.
Key Tasks and Responsibilities
The scope includes, but is not limited to:
Cloud Platform Engineering

Engineer, automate and continuously improve the Azure cloud platform foundation and reusable platform services.
Implement approved architecture, security and operational requirements and contribute to platform standards, lifecycle management and controlled technology adoption.
Improve self-service cloud consumption, developer experience and delivery consistency through standardized platform products and automation.

Terraform, Landing Zones and Automation
Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules, module standards and the approved module catalog, including testing, documentation, versioning and lifecycle management.
Implement and automate platform and application landing zones, subscription provisioning, management-group placement, baseline controls and workload onboarding.
Drive configuration consistency, automation and removal of manual provisioning through controlled code repositories and deployment pipelines.

Governance, Security and DevSecOps
Implement Azure Policy and governance controls as code, translating approved security and compliance requirements into enforceable platform guardrails.
Develop secure Azure DevOps pipelines for Terraform validation, testing, scanning, quality gates, approvals and controlled environment promotion.
Implement Zero Trust controls covering identity, managed identities, privileged access, certificates, Key Vault, private connectivity, network isolation and cloud-native security services.

Cloud Networking and Connectivity
Implement and maintain Virtual WAN, hub-and-spoke, ExpressRoute, VPN, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Private Link, DNS and third-party SD-WAN integrations.
Support secure hybrid, partner and multi-region connectivity and troubleshoot routing, BGP, route propagation, segmentation, traffic inspection and name-resolution issues.

Reliability, Resilience and Observability
Implement reusable zone-redundant, multi-region, backup and disaster-recovery capabilities aligned with availability, RTO and RPO requirements.
Develop Azure-native monitoring, logging and alerting capabilities using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights.
Support resilience testing and ensure platform services are observable, supportable and operationally ready.

Application Enablement and Collaboration
Enable application teams to adopt approved landing zones, Terraform modules, Azure DevOps pipelines and secure platform patterns, including hands-on or temporarily embedded support where required.
Work closely with Cloud Architects on feasibility and implementation, and with Security and Cloud Run teams on controls, operational readiness, incident analysis and service improvement.
Contribute to peer reviews, technical documentation, knowledge transfer, cross-skilling and continuous improvement of the cloud platform.

Technical Competencies and Experience
Proven expertise in designing, implementing and operating enterprise-scale Microsoft Azure environments.
Strong expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, including reusable module development, module lifecycle management and infrastructure automation at scale.
Proven experience implementing and evolving Azure landing zones and cloud foundation services aligned with enterprise governance requirements.
Strong expertise in Azure DevOps, Git-based workflows, CI/CD and DevSecOps practices for cloud infrastructure delivery.
Proven experience implementing policy-as-code through Azure Policy and automated governance controls.
Strong expertise in cloud networking, including Azure Virtual WAN, hub-and-spoke architectures, ExpressRoute, VPN, routing, segmentation and hybrid connectivity.
Practical expertise in implementing and troubleshooting Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Private Endpoints, Private Link and Private DNS services.
Strong understanding of Zero Trust principles and proven experience implementing identity, networking and security controls in Azure.
Proven experience implementing Microsoft Entra ID integrations, managed identities, privileged access controls, certificate management and Azure Key Vault.
Proven experience implementing highly available, zone-redundant and multi-region cloud solutions.

Proven ability to collaborate effectively with architecture, security, operations and application teams in a cloud platform engineering context.

jobs.title: Senior Foundation Engineer (Drive)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right

. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top :1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

Drive Foundation

Drive Foundation is the backbone of Proton Drive. We ensure that cross-client initiatives are executed consistently and efficiently. Whether it’s aligning multiple clients, maintaining documentation or the RFC process, or building robust SDKs, our team lays the groundwork that makes the entire Drive experience work seamlessly.

Current Projects:
We’re currently focused on developing SDK that encapsulate the core functionality of Proton Drive. The SDK comes with two core implementations, one in C# for desktop and mobile clients and second in TypeScript for web client, and higher-level modules in Rust. Our SDK primarily serve internal clients today, but our long-term vision includes integrating them across the Proton ecosystem—and even enabling third-party applications to interface with Drive.

Tech Stack and Tools:
Languages we see daily is C#, TypeScript and Rust. We also need to provide bindings for Swift and Kotlin. We use Grafana and Prometheus to instrument our SDK, Sentry to get details issues from the SDK usage, GitLab CI for running tests including e2e tests written using Playwright, or GitLab in general to work on the code base.

Future Plans:
We are planning to revamp our cryptographic model to boost performance and efficiency across all clients. We will finish ongoing first generation of SDK to cover all core Drive features and new crypto model. Then we will do second generation in Rust with lessons learned and include full support of all features such as Photos, Public Sharing, and Docs.

Impact Opportunities:
Foundation work touches every aspect of Drive. The SDK and infrastructure you build will be used by every Drive client—and getting it right is both critical and deeply rewarding.
Drive is rapidly expanding. As it evolves into a true platform, we expect more teams to emerge—each owning different verticals built on top of Drive. This opens up immense opportunities to grow as an IC, tech lead or engineering manager.
You’ll have the chance to shape not only the future of Drive, but also your own career path in a variety of domains and technologies.

As a Senior Drive Foundation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining the foundational components that power Proton Drive applications. You will work collaboratively with Drive teams, including backend, web, mobile, or desktop developers, to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across various client applications.

What you will do:

Architect and develop core libraries: Lead the design and development of core C#/TypeScript/Rust libraries that serve as the backbone for Proton Drive's applications.
Cross-platform compatibility: Ensure compatibility and optimal performance across various platforms.
Code review and optimization: Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure code quality, maintainability, and performance optimization.
Collaboration: Work closely with backend, frontend, mobile and desktop developers to integrate core libraries seamlessly into Proton Drive's applications.
Testing: Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies, including unit tests and integration tests, to ensure the reliability of core libraries.
Documentation: Create and maintain thorough documentation for core libraries to assist other developers in understanding and utilizing the components.

Job requirements:

5+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on the Rust programming language.
Strong expertise in Rust language features, concurrency, and ownership models.
Web, mobile, and/or desktop development: Experience in developing libraries for client applications.
Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and excellent communication skills.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues efficiently.

Even if you don’t meet all the requirements listed above, but feel you could still be a great fit, please still apply.

What We Offer

Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here)
Work with smart and dedicated people - Our team is diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit with people coming from all walks of life, including many of the world’s top academic institutions and organizations, such as MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, and ETH.
Technology: you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
Learning & Development: we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
Employee Benefits: your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
Stock Options: at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
In-Person Collaboration: Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
Food: Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
Transport: getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
Flexible Working: you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page .

jobs.title: Global OT Application Developer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Developer
builds, maintains, tests and stabilises application components and use cases for industrial environments. The role converts approved requirements, designs and standards into reliable software, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards that can be reused across applications and sites.

The Application Developer works closely with Application Engineers throughout implementation, integration, testing and stabilisation, must understand the operational and technical context in which the solution will run, and remains involved in resolving defects and technical issues. It is not an isolated coding position.

Assigned scope:

Configuration and development of use cases within Global OT applications.
Development and maintenance of standard interfaces between Global OT applications.
Implementation of improvements to ensure correct performance of Global OT applications and interfaces.
Writing and maintaining technical documentation, release notes and other documentation required for proper software governance.

Primary emphasis:

Features that are stable, maintainable and suitable for reuse across applications or sites.
Code and configurations for use cases and interfaces that follow agreed versioning and delivery practices.
Documented components that Application Engineers can integrate, deploy and support.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Build and maintain application components:

Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.
Build and maintain within application domains such as IIoT, MES, SCADA, historians and maintenance systems.
Develop database structures and application interfaces in accordance with the approved design and relevant application practices.
Maintain existing applications and application components and adapt them when approved requirements or standards change.

Test and stabilise:

Take responsibility for the technical quality of the developments and configurations.
Create and execute developer-level tests and support broader functional and integration testing.
Identify, diagnose and correct defects discovered during implementation, testing and stabilisation.
Verify that the code deliverables meet the defined requirements and behave reliably in the target application environment.
Support Application Engineers during integration and deployment when code, configuration or component-level troubleshooting is required.

Reuse, standards and maintainability:

Ensure that development can be governed, maintained and reused beyond a single isolated requirement.
Use reusable logics, UX/UI and features where appropriate.
Follow agreed coding, configuration, naming and documentation standards,
Consider performance, reliability and maintainability when implementing application requirements.
Document code, configurations, dependencies and technical behaviour clearly enough for integration and support.

Controlled delivery and versioning:

Develop within the agreed versioning, review and release process.
Use Git or the agreed source-control platform for versioning and collaboration.
Follow the applicable CI/CD, code-review, testing and release practices
Maintain traceability between approved requirements, implemented changes and delivered versions.
Contribute to the correction and stabilisation of released components when development changes are required.

Collaboration across the application lifecycle:

Work with the Application Owner on approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Work with Application Engineers on technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs.
Clarify functional and technical requirements with the relevant business, engineering and architecture contributors.
Provide transparent estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status to the relevant delivery lead or Scrum Master.
Participate in defect resolution and technical discussions with vendors or system integrators when the developed components are involved.

Application-specific requirements:

SQL and application database development.
Programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning and collaborative development practices.
Implementation, testing, defect correction and feature stabilisation.
CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation covering code, configurations, interfaces and delivered components.
Contribution across IIoT applications and use cases (including platforms such as Ignition), MES applications, historian and industrial-data applications, and maintenance applications, depending on the assigned application background.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Advanced: SQL and application database development, including database structures and application interfaces.
Advanced: programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Proficient: industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning, CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle requirements under IEC 62443-4-1.
Working knowledge of application domains such as IIoT (including platforms such as Ignition), MES, historians and maintenance systems.

Behavioral Competencies:

Structured, pragmatic and quality-oriented, with strong ownership of the technical quality of own deliverables.
Constructive challenge of requirements, designs and technical solutions where quality or maintainability is at risk.
Clear cross-functional communication of estimates, risks, dependencies and delivery status across engineering, business and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in software, computer science, automation, electrical or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience developing and maintaining software components for industrial or manufacturing applications such as IIoT, MES, historians or maintenance systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated ownership of complex application components across multiple applications or sites.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany.
Home-based or hybrid working, including collaboration with nearshore and distributed delivery teams.
Occasional travel to manufacturing sites where development support is required.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Global OT Application Developer is accountable for:

Choosing detailed implementation approaches within approved requirements, architecture and standards.
Identifying technical risks and proposing improvements to components and delivery practices.
Raising concerns about potential future issues — technical debt, scalability, maintainability or obsolescence — to the Application Owner and architecture contributors before they affect operations.
Rejecting code or components that do not meet agreed quality and versioning practices.
Supporting integration, deployment and troubleshooting when development expertise is required.
The role does not own the application roadmap, backlog priorities or acceptance decisions, plant connectivity, site readiness, commissioning or operational support, and does not define platform architecture or approve material deviations from global standards; nor does it operate as an isolated programmer without testing, stabilisation and engineering collaboration.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Application Engineers: technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs; day-to-day collaboration throughout implementation and stabilisation.
Delivery lead / Scrum Master: estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status.
Business, engineering and architecture contributors: clarification of functional and technical requirements.
Vendors and system integrators: defect resolution and technical discussions where the developed components are involved.
Nearshore / distributed delivery teams: shared requirements, standards, testing, versioning and documentation practices; dotted-line collaboration with Application Engineers regardless of location.

jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany, plus a senior regional position in the north-eastern United States.
Home-based or hybrid working with regular domestic and international travel to manufacturing sites.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Application Engineer:

Together with the Project Managers, defines implementation and configuration approaches within approved standards.
Stops or rejects a technical deployment when readiness or acceptance criteria are not met.
Recommends fixes, improvements and standard changes based on operational evidence.
Escalates architecture, security, scope and vendor-performance risks.
The role does not own application strategy, roadmap, backlog or commercial vendor decisions, does not act only as a software developer without integration, testing, support and site responsibilities, does not replace the plant's operational ownership or bypass agreed OT governance, and does not approve material deviations from global standards without the relevant owner or authority.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: priorities, scope, standards, acceptance and escalation of commercial or roadmap matters.
Plant operations and local OT teams: site readiness, deployment activities, onboarding, training, support and operational handover.
Developers, delivery leads and Scrum Masters: build activities, defect resolution, planning and release execution.
Infrastructure and cybersecurity teams: interfaces, security controls, architecture dependencies and technical risk.
Software vendors and system integrators: technical quality, delivery evidence, testing and issue resolution.
Business and functional stakeholders (production, quality, maintenance, supply chain): technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions affecting plant operations.
Project managers: rollout planning and execution; sequencing, dependencies and escalation of deviations.

Join AG Solution Where Talent Shapes Industry 4.0

At AG Solution, we build intelligent solutions for the process industry, combining automation, process control, data management, and MES/MOM systems to help manufacturers reach operational excellence.

Now part of the Quariq Group, we are one of Europe’s leading Industry 4.0 partners

At AG Solution, you’ll work on meaningful projects that drive efficiency, sustainability, and digital transformation for leading manufacturers worldwide.

Built to Scale. Driven by Talent.

Trabajamos en proyectos donde la nube debe integrarse de forma realista con entornos existentes, modernizar aplicaciones críticas y habilitar plataformas empresariales escalables, seguras y conectadas con el ecosistema Microsoft.

¿Qué nos gustaría que aportaras?
Aunque no todo es imprescindible, nos gustaría que contaras con:
Al menos 5 años de experiencia diseñando y evolucionando arquitecturas cloud sobre Microsoft Azure
, en entornos empresariales complejos.
Conocimiento sólido de los servicios esenciales de Azure para el diseño de soluciones: identidad, redes, cómputo, almacenamiento, bases de datos, integración, observabilidad, seguridad y gobierno.

y definiendo arquitecturas escalables, resilientes, seguras y eficientes.

Certificaciones de Microsoft Azure, especialmente Azure Solutions Architect Expert

Experiencia con infraestructura como código y automatización mediante Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates o Azure DevOps.
Conocimiento de Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Arc, plataformas de integración, arquitecturas orientadas a eventos o prácticas DevSecOps.
Participación en iniciativas de gobierno cloud, optimización de costes, Cloud Center of Excellence o evolución de modelos operativos.
Interés por las capacidades de datos e inteligencia artificial del ecosistema Azure y por su integración en arquitecturas empresariales.

Diseñar arquitecturas objetivo en Azure que respondan a necesidades de negocio y equilibren seguridad, escalabilidad, disponibilidad, rendimiento, gobierno y coste.
Definir patrones, estándares y arquitecturas de referencia reutilizables para acelerar el diseño y la adopción de soluciones cloud.

ServiceNow is a global tool used widely to manage business processes of Enterprise clients and our ServiceNow team is part of the global structure of EY as a Global Elite partner of ServiceNow. This also involves the analysis of business requirements at all stages of development. You may have the opportunity to lead a team of consultants during projects or design the architecture of ServiceNow solutions.

NEXT | eDO Tech Graduate Program

You’re a tech or IT student. You’re about to graduate or you have done so for a year or so. You start to wonder about the future. And then you ask yourself what’s next.

eDO is NEXT!

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.

If you’re looking for the best opportunity to start your career in the tech field, then think no more. eDO’s Graduate Program is here to help you ease all of those questions that arise when you are starting to build your career. At eDO you’ll not only learn and develop but also help to shape the future of travel at the world’s leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe using cutting-edge technology.

So, what’s NEXT?

NEXT is a one-year graduate program
developed by eDreams ODIGEO and designed for those who are about to or have recently graduated from a tech-related degree.

It’s focused on personal learning and development and at the same time allowing you to have a real experience of what it is like to work at eDO.

No serving coffees or doing copies, here you’ll have the chance to do real work that has an impact on the company. Ok, maybe a cup of coffee or two because they are free at the office and we can always have a quick break.

What you will do:

The main goal here is to learn. So don’t worry if you still don’t have a lot of experience or knowledge. We got your back.

During NEXT you’ll be able to develop the technical and soft skills that will help you start your career in technology to later keep growing through our career path. NEXT up, these are some of the things to expect:

Work directly in one of our Agile multidisciplinary teams where you will influence products in one of our many areas, such as our booking experience, payments, searches and many more, working with cutting-edge technologies, like Java 8 to Java 11, ES6 code, frameworks like Backbone, Javascript libraries like ReactJS, VueJS and Lodash, Big Data (Kafka, Cassandra, Redis, Neo4j…), BigTable, Docker, Google Cloud, Style Sheet preprocessors like SASS, testing frameworks and libraries like Mocha, Chai, Underscore, Automatic Functional Testing (Selenium + Cucumber + NodeJS) or packages and task runners like WebPack, Babel, Grunt, NPM.
Develop hands-on experience with applied AI development tools, including AI-powered coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot to improve development efficiency, code quality, and team productivity.
A dedicated onboarding and career path, tailored to your needs and goals, with the possibility of choosing a Backend or Frontend path.
Mentoring from experienced peers, with guided training and learning on the job with Senior Developers, Architects, QA Managers and many more.
A true open culture where feedback is king. We work in an open and collaborative environment where every door is open and any idea is valued.

What can I do NEXT?

Apply!

If you’re a recent graduate
from any tech-related field
, such as Computer Science or similar, are f luent in English
and still don’t have a lot of work experience, then what are you waiting for?

Of course, it helps if you have coded before, but more than experience, we’re looking for people with a fresh and proactive attitude
with a sharp analytical mindset
. You’re basically a go-getter
who is always looking for ways to improve and iterate.

A strong interest and demonstrated engagement in AI is a must.

This includes exposure to or hands-on experience with Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or automation, whether through academic coursework, personal projects, online learning, or independent experimentation. Curiosity alone is not enough; you should already be actively exploring or applying AI in some form.

But most importantly, you’re eager to learn!

What can I get NEXT?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At NEXT you’ll have the same benefits as an eDOer. It’s not like we love lists, but here are just some of the main ones:

A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it after 3 years.

Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.

Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.

Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.

Work hard, party hard ! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.

Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

So, think no more and take the NEXT step! Apply now!

eDreams ODIGEO is the world’s leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe. Under its four renowned online travel agency brands – eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo – it serves more than 21 million customers per year across 44 markets. Listed on the Spanish Stock Market, eDreams ODIGEO works with nearly 700 airlines. The business launched Prime, the first subscription product in the travel sector which has topped over 6 million members since launching in 2017. The brand offers the best quality products in regular flights, low-cost airlines, hotels, dynamic packages, car rental and travel insurance to make travel easier, more accessible, and better value for consumers across the globe.

jobs.description:
Septeo es un actor europeo líder en el sector del software con presencia internacional, reconocido como uno de los cinco principales proveedores de software vertical en Francia. En plena fase de rápido crecimiento y transformación constante, el grupo se ha consolidado como un referente en la industria del software, impulsado por la fortaleza de unos equipos decididos, audaces y comprometidos.

En Septeo, la inteligencia artificial es el eje de nuestra evolución. La entendemos como un motor de rendimiento sostenible, colaboración e innovación, integrada de manera responsable en las prácticas cotidianas y democratizada en todas nuestras áreas de negocio. Nuestra ambición es clara: «crear software inteligente para Europa».

Nuestra cultura se cimenta en valores sólidos: ser, hacer y transformar juntos. No es una cultura estática; se vive día a día en nuestras acciones y decisiones, logrando un equilibrio entre rendimiento, responsabilidad y disfrute.

Esta ambición se refleja en nuestra labor diaria: diseñar software que acompaña los momentos esenciales de la vida, al servicio de millones de ciudadanos. Desempeñar un papel en estos momentos clave conlleva una gran responsabilidad. Es una responsabilidad que asumimos con orgullo y que pronto podría ser también la tuya.

Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.

Descripción del empleo

How You’ll Have Impact

Build the Platform Behind the Platform: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
Enable Engineering Velocity: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
Drive Reliability & Observability: Ensure high availability, performance, and real-time visibility across distributed systems.
Architect for Scale: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
Champion Infrastructure as Code: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
Embed Security by Design: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure.
Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or equivalent).
Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (ELK stack, Grafana dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
Operate, monitor, and tune Microsoft SQL Server databases (performance, backups, high availability).
Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate closely with backend engineers (Java / Kotlin, C#, Node.js) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
Leverage AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Codex, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.

You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

Cloud Building Blocks: AWS & Azure

We run workloads on both AWS and Azure. We are looking for solid hands-on experience with IaaS and core managed cloud services on at least one of them — knowing the equivalent on the other cloud is a strong plus. These are the building blocks you’ll work with:

Virtual machines & autoscaling — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets | AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
Virtual networking — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints | AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
L7 load balancing + WAF — Azure: Application Gateway + WAF | AWS: Application Load Balancer + AWS WAF
Web app / API hosting — Azure: App Service | AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
Managed Kubernetes — Azure: AKS | AWS: EKS
Message queues — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues | AWS: Amazon SQS
Object storage — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs | AWS: Amazon S3
In-memory cache — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis | AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
Managed SQL Server — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance | AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
Workload identity (secretless auth) — Azure: Managed Identity + DefaultAzureCredential | AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) + SDK default credential chain
Secrets & keys — Azure: Key Vault | AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
Transactional email — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) | AWS: Amazon SES
Per-environment configuration — Azure: App Settings | AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
Logs, metrics & alerts — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor | AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
Runtime diagnostics — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics | AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

Requisitos

5+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS or Azure — experience with both is a strong plus.
Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with production experience in Kubernetes (required).
Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
Experience with Redis in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
Experience working in high-availability SaaS environments.
Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including Grafana dashboards and alerting.
Automation-first mindset.
Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
Languages: fluent Spanish and professional English (both required).

We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands-on experience with at least one technology in each area: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers & orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases & caching.

Nice-to-Have Superpowers

Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
Experience in multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure.
Scripting skills (Bash, Python).
French — a huge plus (we can dream!).

Información adicional

Participar en la aventura AI First de Septeo y descubrir nuevas formas de trabajar gracias a la inteligencia artificial.
Crecer y desarrollarse gracias a un itinerario de formación personalizado y a oportunidades de movilidad interna.
Vivir una experiencia humana, intercambiar y compartir en eventos temáticos como encuentros afterwork, actividades deportivas, iniciativas de RSC, seminarios y mucho más.
Unirse a un equipo que cuida de los demás y se compromete con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la inclusión.

jobs.title: Backend Developer - Turkish Speaking
jobs.description:
About Codeway

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, Backend at Codeway, you will design, build, and operate the scalable backend services that power mobile apps and web experiences used by millions. You won't just write code; you will own features end-to-end - from initial system design and AI integration to deployment and production monitoring - with a strong focus on API quality, performance, and reliability.

Our environment is fast-paced, and we value engineers who can turn complex architectural challenges into simple, elegant, and maintainable solutions. The ideal candidate will be comfortable building backend services for mobile products and working with API-heavy consumer apps.

You will collaborate with mobile, product, AI, and DevOps teams to ship features end to end, bringing AI-powered capabilities into production where relevant.

What You’ll Be Doing

Design and implement scalable systems. Build high-performance backend architectures and microservices/RESTful APIs for mobile and web clients using Node.js and Python.
Own features end-to-end. Take full responsibility for the lifecycle of your services, from ideation and implementation through to deployment (GCP/Firebase) and continuous optimisation.
Integrate AI and media workflows. Deploy, monitor, and support LLMs and media workflows (STT/TTS, image/video/audio processing) in production, managing model serving, inference performance, and latency/cost tradeoffs.
Architect asynchronous workflows. Implement robust event-driven systems using queues and tasks to handle heavy media and AI workloads.
Simplify systems. Evaluate every component and process to remove unnecessary complexity and build minimalist, future-proof architectures.
Optimise performance. Proactively identify bottlenecks across distributed systems to improve latency, throughput, reliability, and costs.
Ensure backend quality. Establish robust error handling, security best practices, and end-to-end observability, and contribute to code quality through reviews, testing, and documentation.
Troubleshoot and stabilise. Debug issues and proactively improve system stability and observability in production environments.
Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with Mobile, Frontend, Product, DevOps, and AI teams to design and ship impactful features.

What You’ll Bring

Experience. 3+ years of professional experience as a Backend Engineer, with a track record of building consumer-facing products at scale.
Technical excellence. Strong hands-on proficiency in both Node.js and Python, with a deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
System design. Experience designing and working with microservices architectures and RESTful APIs, with a solid grasp of databases, data modelling, performance optimisation, and security best practices.
Infrastructure knowledge. Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as GCP, AWS, or Azure (GCP and/or Firebase preferred), with strong production debugging and observability habits.
AI familiarity. Experience deploying and optimising AI models in production, including familiarity with external AI APIs and their performance considerations.
Scale. Ability to contribute effectively in high-scale environments handling large volumes of traffic and data, with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Communication. Proficiency in English and Turkish, with the ability to explain complex engineering decisions and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical teams.
Education. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to have

Experience supporting mobile apps through backend APIs.
Experience with GCP tools such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, or App Engine.
Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
Familiarity with SSE or WebSockets for real-time communication.
Experience with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS.

What We Offer

The chance to work with a high-caliber, passionate international team building category-defining products
Full-time contract with competitive salary
Private health insurance, a generous meal card
Full visa & relocation support if you’re moving to Barcelona
Annual learning & development budget for courses, tools, or events that support your growth
Wellness perks, including sports budget and psychological consultations.
Free access to Codeway’s suite of apps across productivity, wellness, and education
A top-notch office in the heart of the city

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
NTT DATA
es una consultora multinacional que ofrece soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría.

Digital Technology
es la unidad enfocada a acompañar a las grandes organizaciones iberoamericanas en su transformación digital, generando dividendos digitales a través de la tecnología y el diseño, con enfoque práctico y orientado al negocio. Para lograrlo, buscamos personas que compartan nuestra curiosidad permanente, pasión por la tecnología, excelencia constante y visión estratégica.

Digital Architecture
es la división que proporciona la estrategia tecnológica y las plataformas IT necesarias para impulsar la digitalización y transformación de nuestros clientes, ofreciendo soluciones cloud-native y siendo referentes en la construcción de arquitecturas robustas, seguras y que contemplen todas las necesidades.

Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo de arquitectura en Azure
y buscamos perfiles capaces de diseñar soluciones que combinen innovación, gobierno y fiabilidad operativa. Personas con criterio para conectar necesidades de negocio, requisitos regulatorios y decisiones tecnológicas, construyendo arquitecturas preparadas para evolucionar. Como Microsoft Gold Partner
, en NTT DATA impulsamos soluciones sobre Azure que combinan innovación tecnológica, gobierno y cumplimiento normativo. Trabajamos en proyectos donde la nube debe integrarse de forma realista con entornos existentes, modernizar aplicaciones críticas y habilitar plataformas empresariales escalables, seguras y conectadas con el ecosistema Microsoft.

¿Qué nos gustaría que aportaras?
Aunque no todo es imprescindible, nos gustaría que contaras con:
Al menos 5 años de experiencia diseñando y evolucionando arquitecturas cloud sobre Microsoft Azure
, en entornos empresariales complejos.
Conocimiento sólido de los servicios esenciales de Azure para el diseño de soluciones: identidad, redes, cómputo, almacenamiento, bases de datos, integración, observabilidad, seguridad y gobierno.
Experiencia aplicando principios del Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework
y definiendo arquitecturas escalables, resilientes, seguras y eficientes.
Capacidad para diseñar y evolucionar entornos híbridos, conectando Azure con infraestructuras on-premise , otras nubes y el ecosistema Microsoft.
Experiencia en la definición de landing zones , modelos de gobierno, estructuras de suscripciones, políticas, gestión de identidades y controles de cumplimiento.
Conocimiento de estrategias de modernización y migración de aplicaciones, valorando alternativas basadas en servicios PaaS, contenedores, arquitecturas serverless o plataformas gestionadas.
Criterio para abordar decisiones de seguridad y cumplimiento: Microsoft Entra ID, gestión de secretos, segmentación de red, cifrado, monitorización, auditoría y protección de cargas.
Capacidad para colaborar con equipos de ingeniería, plataformas, ciberseguridad, datos y responsables de negocio, facilitando decisiones técnicas alineadas con los objetivos del proyecto.

También valoraremos positivamente:
Certificaciones de Microsoft Azure, especialmente Azure Solutions Architect Expert
, o experiencia práctica alineada con sus dominios de conocimiento.
Experiencia con infraestructura como código y automatización mediante Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates o Azure DevOps.
Conocimiento de Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Arc, plataformas de integración, arquitecturas orientadas a eventos o prácticas DevSecOps.
Participación en iniciativas de gobierno cloud, optimización de costes, Cloud Center of Excellence o evolución de modelos operativos.
Interés por las capacidades de datos e inteligencia artificial del ecosistema Azure y por su integración en arquitecturas empresariales.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
Diseñar arquitecturas objetivo en Azure que respondan a necesidades de negocio y equilibren seguridad, escalabilidad, disponibilidad, rendimiento, gobierno y coste.
Definir patrones, estándares y arquitecturas de referencia reutilizables para acelerar el diseño y la adopción de soluciones cloud.
Diseñar y evolucionar landing zones , modelos de gobierno y controles técnicos que permitan utilizar Azure de forma segura, ordenada y escalable.
Acompañar proyectos de modernización, migración e integración híbrida, ayudando a seleccionar el enfoque tecnológico más adecuado para cada caso.
Evaluar decisiones de arquitectura, identificar riesgos y proponer alternativas ante retos de conectividad, identidad, integración, cumplimiento o operación.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, plataformas y ciberseguridad para asegurar que los diseños se llevan a la práctica de forma consistente y sostenible.
Facilitar conversaciones entre equipos técnicos y responsables de negocio, transformando necesidades complejas en decisiones de arquitectura y roadmaps accionables.
Contribuir al desarrollo de la práctica de Azure mediante la compartición de conocimiento, la creación de activos reutilizables y la exploración de capacidades relevantes del ecosistema Microsoft.

📍 Aunque nuestra búsqueda está centrada principalmente en Barcelona, también tenemos equipos en Barcelona, Coruña, Bilbao, Madrid, Oviedo, Sevilla, Valencia, Valladolid y Zaragoza. Por lo que si vives en estas u otras ciudades también nos interesa tu perfil y estaremos encantados de conocerte.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
🧠 Formar parte de un equipo de élite especializado en la unión entre estrategia y tecnología.
💼 Contrato indefinido con revisiones de categoría y salario de manera anual.
🎓 Certificaciones bonificadas de los principales proveedores cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) y otras tecnologías.
📝 Acceso gratuito a nuestra plataforma formativa, NTT DATA University , donde encontrarás formaciones técnicas, metodológicas, idiomas y soft skills.
💻 Trabajo híbrido y horario flexible para facilitar la conciliación.
📅 Jornada intensiva (8:00 a 15:00) los viernes y los meses de verano.
🏥 Beneficios corporativos: complementos salariales adicionales, retribución flexible, seguro médico, seguro de vida y accidentes y muchos más.
🌊 Programas solidarios y actividades sociales para impulsar un impacto positivo a través de nuestro portal de voluntarios The Blue Wave .
🔝 Un ambiente de trabajo excelente, que fomenta el compañerismo y la buena convivencia. Somos Global Top Employer 2025, y, en España, por 10º año consecutivo.
🌏 Innovación diversa y cultura inclusiva. En NTT DATA creemos que cada persona es única y apostamos por una cultura que valora la diversidad y fomenta un entorno donde todos podamos explorar y potenciar nuestra singularidad.

¡Únete al equipo de Digital Technology en NTT DATA!

Experiencia en definición de arquitecturas de integración

como AWS, Azure o Google Cloud, así como en arquitecturas híbridas, microservicios, contenedores o despliegues cloud-native.

Wil jij bouwen aan software die dagelijks door honderden organisaties wordt gebruikt?

Als Junior Software Developer bij Tools4ever werk je mee aan HelloID, onze Identity & Access Management-cloudsoftware. Je komt terecht in een team waar je kunt leren van ervaren developers en waar je stap voor stap meer verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Je werkt aan echte software die door veel organisaties wordt gebruikt. Daarbij denk je mee over slimme oplossingen, los je technische puzzels op en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen. Zo groei je in je rol, zonder dat je alles al hoeft te weten.

Bij Tools4ever werk je in een omgeving waar duidelijkheid, kwaliteit en samenwerking belangrijk zijn. Je krijgt heldere doelen en weet wat er van je wordt verwacht. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en je eigen keuzes goed te onderbouwen. Je denkt mee over praktische oplossingen, schrijft nette en onderhoudbare code en leert steeds beter hoe je software bouwt die betrouwbaar is in de praktijk.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar staat er niet alleen voor: je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s en kunt vragen stellen wanneer dat nodig is. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf verder, terwijl je vanaf het begin echt meedraait in het team.

Wat ga je doen?

In je gestructureerde en zelfsturende team ontwikkel je hoogwaardige cloud software namelijk HelloID. Onze SaaS cloud oplossing HelloID is voor veel bedrijven dé oplossing op hun Identity Management vraagstukken. Samen zorgen de teams ervoor dat er software wordt geleverd waar onze klanten met plezier mee werken; wat altijd in de lucht is en wat veilig is.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van hoogwaardige C# .NET cloudsoftware
Werken als junior developer binnen een moderne SaaS-architectuur
Schrijven van schone, onderhoudbare en goed geteste code
Nauwkeurig inschatten van de werklast in een stand up meeting elke ochtend
Leren over cloud based webapplicaties

Je weet wanneer je hulp en advies nodig hebt en biedt dit ook aan anderen. Na elke sprint lever je de software op (DevOps) en kun je zelfstandig releases beheren. Je draagt bij aan de sprint review (demo) voor de stakeholders. Voor meer inzicht in de werkzaamheden van onze softwareontwikkelaars, lees dan hier onze roadmap: roadmap.helloid.com.

Onze tech-stack

Talen: C#, TypeScript

Frameworks: .NET (Core), Angular

Cloud & infrastructuur: Google Cloud, Azure, Kubernetes

Databases: MongoDB, SQL

Tools & methodieken: Visual Studio, Git, DevOps, Agile/Scrum

Wie zijn wij?

Bij Tools4ever draait alles om slimme oplossingen, teamwork en plezier. Met meer dan 800 actieve klanten is Tools4ever marktleider in Nederland op het gebied van Identity Governance & Administration. Onze oplossingen worden gebruikt door organisaties van 200 tot 30.000 medewerkers in alle sectoren, zoals de zorg, detailhandel, (semi)overheid en commerciële sectoren. Onze klanten zijn onder andere de gemeente Amsterdam, Revant, Naturalis en Codarts.

Maar die sfeer proef je ook op ons kantoor in Baarn: we lunchen samen, organiseren regelmatig leuke uitjes (minstens één per kwartaal), bieden verschillende sportieve activiteiten aan en doen in de zomer én winter iets gezelligs met elkaar, zoals samen skiën. Bij Tools4ever krijg je vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid in een gedreven en pragmatische cultuur. We kijken altijd naar de impact op onze belangrijkste drijfveren: medewerkerstevredenheid en klanttevredenheid.

We ontwikkelen ons product volledig in eigen beheer, zonder externe investeerders. Dat geeft rust, focus en ruimte voor kwaliteit en innovatie. Software development is bij ons geen ondersteunende afdeling, maar het hart van de organisatie.

Jouw team

Onze developers zijn verdeeld in drie gestructureerde teams: één Service Automation-team en twee Provisioning-teams, elk bestaande uit ongeveer zes collega’s. Daarnaast zijn er twee Product Owners die betrokken zijn bij alle drie de teams.

Onze Developers voeren gemiddeld 1-2 taken per dag uit, afhankelijk van de complexiteit van de taak. Deze taken worden gezamenlijk en nauwkeurig besproken tijdens de dagelijkse stand-up meeting. In deze teams zijn zelfstandigheid, pragmatisme en samenwerking essentieel. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat ons product HelloID efficiënt en optimaal functioneert.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt al wat ervaring als developer en wilt je verder ontwikkelen. Je werkt zelfstandig aan je taken, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk en denkt praktisch mee. Ook werk je nauwkeurig en draag je graag bij aan een team waar samenwerking en kwaliteit belangrijk zijn.

Daarnaast Beschik Je Over

Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding
Minimaal één jaar werkervaring als Developer, buiten stages om
Het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, met de ondersteuning van je team wanneer dat nodig is

Het sollicitatieproces

Wij streven ernaar om binnen 48 uur na jouw sollicitatie contact met je op te nemen. Komt jouw profiel in aanmerking en word je uitgenodigd voor een gesprek streven wij dit binnen 3 weken af te handelen.

Betrouwbaarheid en integriteit zijn voor ons essentieel. Daarom vragen wij voor deze functie een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).

new_jobs.description:
Breng data, AI en innovatie samen in een unieke omgeving. Als Data & AI Platform Architect bouw je aan slimme oplossingen die de digitale toekomst van Feadship vormgeven en direct bijdragen aan de bouw van 's werelds mooiste superjachten.

Jouw aandeel in de bouw van een Feadship

Bij Royal van Lent Shipyards op de Kaag bouwen we unieke superjachten van 70 tot 100 meter. Van begin tot eind exact zoals de klant wenst. Deze jachten worden gekenmerkt door innovatie, schoonheid en betrouwbaarheid.
Daar lever jij een belangrijke bijdrage aan. Een Feadship bouwen vraagt expertise en we waarderen jouw vakmanschap op het gebied van IT, finance, control, logistiek, HR of facility. Neem jij de ruimte om op jouw manier te doen waar je goed in bent?

Dit ga je doen als Data & AI Platform Architect

Als Data & AI Platform Architect ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen business en technologie. Je vertaalt informatiebehoeften naar slimme data- en AI-oplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat deze veilig, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig worden ingericht.
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert data- en AI-oplossingen die bijdragen aan datagedreven besluitvorming.
Je vertaalt wensen vanuit de business naar concrete functionaliteiten en begeleidt de realisatie hiervan.
Je optimaliseert ons dataplatform en bouwt mee aan een schaalbare data-architectuur.
Je initieert en realiseert AI-projecten, van use case tot succesvolle ingebruikname.

Dit breng je mee

Ervaring met Power BI, datamodellering, ETL-processen, datalakes en datawarehouses.

Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar praktische oplossingen.
Je bent creatief, innovatief en continu op zoek naar verbeteringen en nieuwe toepassingen van AI.
Je combineert technische diepgang met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en weet stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Onze Voorkeur Gaat Uit Naar Kandidaten Met

Ervaring met AI-technologieën, machine learning en generatieve AI-oplossingen.
Kennis van data governance, datakwaliteit en Master Data Management (MDM).
Ervaring met het ontwerpen van schaalbare dataarchitecturen en het realiseren van complexe datatransformaties.
