new_jobs.title: Global OT Application Developer
new_jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Developer
builds, maintains, tests and stabilises application components and use cases for industrial environments. The role converts approved requirements, designs and standards into reliable software, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards that can be reused across applications and sites.

The Application Developer works closely with Application Engineers throughout implementation, integration, testing and stabilisation, must understand the operational and technical context in which the solution will run, and remains involved in resolving defects and technical issues. It is not an isolated coding position.

Assigned scope:

Configuration and development of use cases within Global OT applications.
Development and maintenance of standard interfaces between Global OT applications.
Implementation of improvements to ensure correct performance of Global OT applications and interfaces.
Writing and maintaining technical documentation, release notes and other documentation required for proper software governance.

Primary emphasis:

Features that are stable, maintainable and suitable for reuse across applications or sites.
Code and configurations for use cases and interfaces that follow agreed versioning and delivery practices.
Documented components that Application Engineers can integrate, deploy and support.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Build and maintain application components:

Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.
Build and maintain within application domains such as IIoT, MES, SCADA, historians and maintenance systems.
Develop database structures and application interfaces in accordance with the approved design and relevant application practices.
Maintain existing applications and application components and adapt them when approved requirements or standards change.

Test and stabilise:

Take responsibility for the technical quality of the developments and configurations.
Create and execute developer-level tests and support broader functional and integration testing.
Identify, diagnose and correct defects discovered during implementation, testing and stabilisation.
Verify that the code deliverables meet the defined requirements and behave reliably in the target application environment.
Support Application Engineers during integration and deployment when code, configuration or component-level troubleshooting is required.

Reuse, standards and maintainability:

Ensure that development can be governed, maintained and reused beyond a single isolated requirement.
Use reusable logics, UX/UI and features where appropriate.
Follow agreed coding, configuration, naming and documentation standards,
Consider performance, reliability and maintainability when implementing application requirements.
Document code, configurations, dependencies and technical behaviour clearly enough for integration and support.

Controlled delivery and versioning:

Develop within the agreed versioning, review and release process.
Use Git or the agreed source-control platform for versioning and collaboration.
Follow the applicable CI/CD, code-review, testing and release practices
Maintain traceability between approved requirements, implemented changes and delivered versions.
Contribute to the correction and stabilisation of released components when development changes are required.

Collaboration across the application lifecycle:

Work with the Application Owner on approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Work with Application Engineers on technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs.
Clarify functional and technical requirements with the relevant business, engineering and architecture contributors.
Provide transparent estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status to the relevant delivery lead or Scrum Master.
Participate in defect resolution and technical discussions with vendors or system integrators when the developed components are involved.

Application-specific requirements:

SQL and application database development.
Programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning and collaborative development practices.
Implementation, testing, defect correction and feature stabilisation.
CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation covering code, configurations, interfaces and delivered components.
Contribution across IIoT applications and use cases (including platforms such as Ignition), MES applications, historian and industrial-data applications, and maintenance applications, depending on the assigned application background.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Advanced: SQL and application database development, including database structures and application interfaces.
Advanced: programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Proficient: industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning, CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle requirements under IEC 62443-4-1.
Working knowledge of application domains such as IIoT (including platforms such as Ignition), MES, historians and maintenance systems.

Behavioral Competencies:

Structured, pragmatic and quality-oriented, with strong ownership of the technical quality of own deliverables.
Constructive challenge of requirements, designs and technical solutions where quality or maintainability is at risk.
Clear cross-functional communication of estimates, risks, dependencies and delivery status across engineering, business and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in software, computer science, automation, electrical or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience developing and maintaining software components for industrial or manufacturing applications such as IIoT, MES, historians or maintenance systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated ownership of complex application components across multiple applications or sites.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany.
Home-based or hybrid working, including collaboration with nearshore and distributed delivery teams.
Occasional travel to manufacturing sites where development support is required.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Global OT Application Developer is accountable for:

Choosing detailed implementation approaches within approved requirements, architecture and standards.
Identifying technical risks and proposing improvements to components and delivery practices.
Raising concerns about potential future issues — technical debt, scalability, maintainability or obsolescence — to the Application Owner and architecture contributors before they affect operations.
Rejecting code or components that do not meet agreed quality and versioning practices.
Supporting integration, deployment and troubleshooting when development expertise is required.
The role does not own the application roadmap, backlog priorities or acceptance decisions, plant connectivity, site readiness, commissioning or operational support, and does not define platform architecture or approve material deviations from global standards; nor does it operate as an isolated programmer without testing, stabilisation and engineering collaboration.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Application Engineers: technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs; day-to-day collaboration throughout implementation and stabilisation.
Delivery lead / Scrum Master: estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status.
Business, engineering and architecture contributors: clarification of functional and technical requirements.
Vendors and system integrators: defect resolution and technical discussions where the developed components are involved.
Nearshore / distributed delivery teams: shared requirements, standards, testing, versioning and documentation practices; dotted-line collaboration with Application Engineers regardless of location.

new_jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
new_jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

new_jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Database Migration Service
new_jobs.description:
Description

Database Migration for Amazon RDS is fully managed, serverless capability that enables customers to migrate SQL Server/Oracle workloads - whether running on Amazon RDS, Amazon EC2, on-premises infrastructure, or other cloud providers - to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Customers simply provide source and target connection details, and the service orchestrates the entire migration lifecycle end-to-end: pre-migration assessment, schema conversion, data movement.

In addition to a traditional console-driven experience, the service introduces an agentic migration workflow. Customers can initiate and manage migrations through natural language within the developer tools they already use - such as Kiro, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. The AI agent assesses the source environment, converts the schema, moves the data, validates the outcome - removing friction and reducing the expertise required to complete complex database migrations.

Amazon RDS is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement scalable, serverless microservices that power the migration lifecycle - assessment, schema conversion, data movement;
Develop intelligent, agent-driven migration workflows that integrate with modern developer tools and leverage natural language interfaces;
Own the end-to-end migration lifecycle - from pre-migration assessment and schema conversion through data movement phases;
Solve hard distributed systems challenges around reliability, security, and performance for customers migrating their most critical production workloads;
Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and AI/ML to deliver a seamless, low-friction migration experience that removes traditional barriers to database modernization;
Mentor SDE Is through code reviews, design guidance, and pair programming;
Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence initiatives.

A day in the life

You might start the day with participating in a design review for a new feature: parallel data movement for multi-terabyte databases. You whiteboard trade-offs between consistency guarantees and throughput, debating how to minimize downtime during cutover windows. Later, you pair with a teammate to debug a race condition in the serverless orchestration layer that surfaces only under high concurrency.

About The Team

You'll join a team of curious, driven engineers who believe that technical excellence and world-class reliability are not aspirations - they are the baseline our customers deserve. If you want to build something that matters, alongside people who challenge and inspire you, this is the place.

This is a rare opportunity to design and operate systems at true cloud scale while developing deep expertise across three of the most transformative domains in modern engineering: cloud computing, database technologies, and artificial intelligence.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
Experience in professional, non-internship software development
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Experience in development in the last 3 years

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Department

IT & Automation, Drug Substance Manufacturing, Global Manufacturing & Supply

Location

Kalundborg, Denmark. Your main base is close to the manufacturing sites. Travel to partner locations in the Copenhagen area may occur on an ad hoc basis but is not a regular work location.

Your impact begins here

As a Computerized Systems Engineer, you keep the computerized equipment, smart instruments and IT/OT systems behind large-scale drug substance production running reliably and in a validated, GMP-compliant state. Your work supports consistent, stable operations that colleagues in production depend on every day—helping ensure the medicines people living with serious chronic diseases rely on can be made safely and on time.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a proactive, collaborative colleague who is eager to develop within computerized systems, digital manufacturing and IT/OT support in a GMP-regulated environment.

Essential

A B.Sc., M.Sc., AP Degree or similar within IT, Engineering, Automation, Instrumentation, Computer Science or a related technical field.
Full professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.
An interest in learning GMP requirements and maintaining systems in a validated environment.
A structured, solution-oriented approach, ownership of your tasks and genuine enjoyment of working with different stakeholders.

Useful, But Not Essential

Experience from IT, automation, instrumentation, manufacturing support, laboratory systems or technical support functions. Recent graduates with relevant internships, student jobs or project work are also encouraged to apply.

Experience with incident and change management, user administration, system maintenance, SOPs, backup and recovery, or supplier coordination.
Familiarity with validation, data integrity, IT security, risk assessments, infrastructure or computerized systems lifecycle management.

What You'll Do

You'll help secure reliable, compliant operations across production by maintaining the systems that keep manufacturing moving. In practice, you will:

Maintain and support computerized equipment, smart instruments and related IT components to ensure availability, reliability and operational stability.
Contribute to ongoing process validation (OPV) and periodic reviews, and manage Operation and Maintenance SOPs through their full lifecycle.
Support incident, problem, deviation and change management, and coordinate patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, restore planning and user access in line with quality and validation requirements.
Identify IT and computerized equipment risks and complete IT risk assessments covering security, data integrity, infrastructure, coding/configuration, smart instruments and operational support.

What You Can Expect Here

Start now

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.
Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.
Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.
Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.
Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.
Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

You’re a great match if

You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team
You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off
You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them
You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team
You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

Nice to have

Experience working on live games

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture
You value a positive work environment
You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

Job Description

Design and implement workflow‑based control automation for Regulatory Standards (e.g., ISO, PCI) and SOX 404 ITGCs, using:
Explicit start–action–evidence–end flows.
Triggers from tickets, change‑management systems, HR events, or IAM changes.
Delivered via tools such as n8n, Camunda, Azure Logic Apps, or custom MCP‑style servers.

Build and operate MCP‑style or MCP‑compatible servers that expose:
Tools: RESTful endpoints for “trigger evidence collection”, “run access review”, “validate change ticket”, etc..
Resources: Standardized data sources (logs, IAM, ticket data) formatted for AI agents or workflow engines.
Auth patterns: API keys, bearer tokens, OAuth2, or OIDC‑style flows that can be consumed by agents or external tools.

Engineer API‑first automation:
Write scripts and connectors (Python, Node.js, Bash, etc.) that call, compose, and orchestrate APIs from:
IAM, IdP, PAM, HRIS, ticketing, cloud IAM, and logging platforms, etc.
GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, 6clicks, or similar) via REST APIs.

Implement:
Authentication and authorization (API keys, Bearer, OAuth2, JWT, Basic, MTLS).
Pagination, retry with backoff, rate‑limiting, and safe error handling.
Idempotency and safe state transitions for audit‑critical operations.

Translate ISO 27001 controls and SOX 404 ITGCs into automated workflows:
Example pattern:
Trigger: new user join or role change in IAM.
Action: call APIs to validate entitlements, cross‑check against SoD, and emit evidence to a GRC tool.
Outcome: workflow‑generated record for ISO 27001 access control and SOX logical‑access control.

Maintain one source of truth for control logic (code / config) and use workflow IDs as control‑evidence bindings.

Design AI‑agent‑ready interfaces:
Expose structured, MCP‑style endpoints or OpenAPI specs so that LLM agents or workflow tools can call concrete tools (e.g., “get latest access review for System X”, “run change‑ticket‑completeness check”).
Handle dynamic policy enforcement: short‑lived tokens, context‑aware access, and audit logging for each AI or agent call.

Integrate with data platforms and SIEM/logging:
Use logs, change tickets, and identity events as workflow inputs.
Build automated tests for control effectiveness (e.g., “if a production change is not approved, fire an alert and record as control failure”) linked to ISO / SOX control IDs.

Maintain audit‑ready workflow artifacts:
Log all workflow steps, including timestamps, input, user/agent context, and outputs.
Ensure workflow outputs are machinable (JSON, structured logs) and can be replayed or reasoned over by auditors or AI agents.

Requirements

Students currently pursuing Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or related disciplines.
Strong understanding of authorization and authentication:
API keys, Bearer tokens, OAuth2 (client, JWT, PKCE), Basic Auth, MTLS, and OIDC‑style flows.
Hands‑on experience implementing these in Python, Node.js, or Go (or similar).

Deep practical experience with:
RESTful APIs: understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, pagination, rate‑limiting, and idempotency.
API clients: writing or using libraries that handle auth, retries, and error handling for large datasets.

Experience building or integrating with:
Workflow / orchestration tools (n8n, Airflow, Logic Apps, Camunda, etc.) or MCP‑style servers / Model Context Protocol‑compatible tooling.
GRC platforms via APIs (e.g., ServiceNow, 6clicks, or similar).

Familiarity with:
ISO 27001 (especially Annex A controls related to access management, change control, and operations).
SOX 404 ITGCs (logical access, change management, computer operations, data integrity).

Full-time interns preferred
Part-time interns who can commit at least 3 working days a week are also welcome to apply

Preferred Qualifications

OpenAPI / Swagger to MCP‑style tool generation (e.g., converting production APIs into MCP servers or AI‑agent tools).
Experience with MCP servers or similar control‑plane architectures that expose tools, resources, and prompts for AI agents.
Background in security automation, CI/CD, or DevSecOps (number of tools: n8n, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, logging pipelines).
Prior involvement in SOX 404 audits and ISO 27001 certification projects, with a focus on how to automate evidence collection rather than manual spreadsheets.

Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across every channel. Behind these capabilities are engineering teams that must understand both the platform’s architecture and the regulated, complex environments where customers operate.

The FDE role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You will be embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA customers — working directly with their teams to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build what’s needed to unblock adoption and expansion.

This is not a support role. You don’t wait for tickets. You operate inside cross-functional Customer Pods — small, autonomous teams with end-to-end ownership — translating customer problems into working platform solutions. You lead with architecture, prototype rapidly, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers.

What You’ll Do

Partner directly with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives
Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes
Investigate and troubleshoot production-level platform issues — from data ingestion and identity resolution to journey orchestration and audience activation
Design and validate end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and adjacent Adobe systems
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that earn customer trust before any commercial motion
Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate on new capabilities — using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of execution
Bridge the gap between customer needs, product direction, and engineering implementation — feeding field patterns back into the product roadmap
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts — from initial discovery through implementation, go-live, and expansion

What Succes Looks Like

We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates will show:

Customer-to-Solution Thinking — you connect customer problems, workflows, and business goals with practical technical solutions — collapsing the gap between requirement and working platform capability
Architecture with Execution — you don’t just design; you prototype, validate, debug, and iterate. Your architectures work because you’ve built them, not just drawn them
Production Awareness — you understand how distributed systems behave at scale — data integrity, graceful degradation, and observability are part of how you think, not afterthoughts
Enterprise Navigation — you operate across complex organizational boundaries, regulatory constraints, and multi-stakeholder environments with confidence and credibility
AI-Augmented Execution — you use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a standard part of how you design, prototype, and deliver
Adaptability Under Ambiguity — you navigate evolving environments where experimentation, learning, and iteration are core to the process — and you don’t mistake seniority for certainty

Typical background: 8–15+ years across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering roles. What matters is what that experience has produced — not the title or the number of years.

Your Domain

AEP / RTCDP / AJO: Adobe’s core platform — data ingestion, segmentation, journey orchestration, audience activation
Enterprise Architecture: Multi-system integration, data flows, identity resolution, API design across complex landscapes
Security & Compliance: Regulated industries (FSI, Healthcare), data sovereignty, privacy-preserving architectures, GDPR
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure — infrastructure patterns, managed services, networking
Data Platforms: Event-driven architectures, streaming pipelines, batch processing, data lakes
Observability: Platform health, SLO definition, performance governance, production monitoring

What We Value

Beyond technical execution, the people who grow fastest on this team demonstrate:

Agency - You identify problems before they are assigned to you and drive them to resolution
Product Judgment - You understand what the platform needs to do for customers, not just what the ticket says to build
Customer Empathy -You earn trust by understanding the customer’s world — their constraints, pressures, and what success looks like for them
Builder Mindset - You are as comfortable prototyping a new capability as you are presenting an architecture to a CT

Nice to Have
:

Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products (AEP, AJO, RTCDP, CJA, Target)
Experience with similar platforms - CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms
Background in regulated industries (Financial Services, Healthcare, Government) and familiarity with their compliance and security constraints
Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration patterns
Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification systems
Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar)
Track record of driving architecture decisions or technical strategy at team or org level

Why This Team

Work on complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact — your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks
Operate inside autonomous, cross-functional Pods embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA accounts
Combine architecture, strategy, engineering, and customer engagement in a single role — no two weeks look the same
Shape a new engineering engagement model centered around rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution
Collaborate with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams
Build engineering credibility that earns expansion rights — from workshops to FDE to renewals

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

new_jobs.description:
Project Description: Product verification & testing for an L1-L3 Traffic Generator Solution for a Global Networking Testing and Validation equipment provider.

Our team: A team of networking enthusiasts willing to contribute to customer success.

Technologies used: Networking protocols, traffic generation tools, Windows/Linux servers, network virtualization, network management tools, microservices.

Opportunities: Networking and testing certifications, collaboration with an international team of professionals, working with the latest networking technologies and concepts, access to training.

Responsibilities

o Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.
o Derive automation requirements from manual functional test specifications and hardware validation reports
o Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
o Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
o Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
o Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
o Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
o Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
o Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
o Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
o Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
o Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.

Qualifications

o Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
o QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);
Python strongly preferred (other comparable languages considered).
o Automated Testing for API or CLI 4+ years, including experience in test harness or framework
development.
o Hands-on experience automating Spirent TestCenter (STC) using its Python API — specifically StcPython
native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability
to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics
retrieval.
o Familiarity with STC Lab Server architecture: connecting to chassis, managing test sessions, and
executing automated sequences without GUI dependency.
o Experience writing and maintaining long-running automation suites (soak tests of days/weeks duration)
with robust result collection, error handling, and reporting.
o Working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols exercised through STC: Ethernet, VLAN/QinQ, BGP (v4/v6),
OSPF (v2/v3), IS-IS, MPLS/LDP, BFD, and data-center protocols such as VXLAN and EVPN; ability to
configure emulated/simulated router topologies for scale and convergence testing.
o Familiarity with RFC 2544 / RFC 2889 benchmarking methodology for throughput, latency, frame loss and
back-to-back testing.
o Practical experience with AI tooling in day-to-day activities to improve productivity and delivery quality
(code generation, code review, automation, agentic AI, MCP usage, etc.).
o Experience in performance, scale, and convergence testing; ability to analyze and improve performance
and convergence at system level.
o Ability to develop and publish solution validation documents and test reports.
o Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across QA and
Development teams.
o Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to collaborate cross-functionally to meet challenging goals.

new_jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.
To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.
Software Developer

.

new_jobs.title: SENIOR .NET DEVELOPER
new_jobs.description:
Vervoeg een Belgisch adviesbureau dat dagelijks duizenden ondernemers, kmo’s en vrije beroepen ondersteunt in hun groei en strategische keuzes met fiscaal, juridisch en zakelijk advies. Technologie speelt daarbij een grote rol. Met oplossingen die enerzijds interne processen verbeteren en anderzijds klanten rechtstreeks ondersteunen in hun dagelijkse werking.

Voor jou als developer betekent dit een omgeving waar technologie geen bijzaak is maar een essentieel onderdeel van de dienstverlening. Ze ontwikkelen digitale platformen en tools die klanten helpen efficiënter en slimmer te werken. En bouwen interne applicaties waarmee collega’s hun dienstverlening verder optimaliseren.

De bedrijfscultuur draait rond duurzame samenwerking en persoonlijke groei. Medewerkers krijgen de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen, initiatief te tonen en zich verder te ontwikkelen. Open communicatie, respect en collegialiteit staan daarbij centraal.

FUNCTIE

Je creëert nieuwe webapplicaties, API’s en features
met C#, .Net, Entity Framework, MsSQL, Git, CI/CD, MediatR, PrimeNg, AutoMapper, Power BI, Azure DevOps, Swagger, Unit testing, …. Indien je Full Stack wenst plus TypeScript / Angular.
Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelingsproces
: van het uittekenen van de analyse en architectuur tot testing en deployment.
Technisch adviseur
. Je ondersteunt collega’s binnen het R&D-team door je kennis te delen en te helpen bij technische vragen. En ondersteunt collega’s uit andere afdelingen door workshops te geven over hoe de software die jij ontwikkelde te gebruiken.

PROFIEL

Vanaf ongeveer 4 jaar ervaring in .Net
development.
Je bent oplossingsgericht, proactief en denkt graag mee na over het continu optimaliseren van de software.
Je bent communicatief en behulpzaam, staat graag in contact met collega’s om hen te helpen maar ook om te sparren en zelf bij te leren.
Nederlands en Engels.

new_jobs.title: Senior Foundation Engineer (Drive)
new_jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right

. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top :1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

Drive Foundation

Drive Foundation is the backbone of Proton Drive. We ensure that cross-client initiatives are executed consistently and efficiently. Whether it’s aligning multiple clients, maintaining documentation or the RFC process, or building robust SDKs, our team lays the groundwork that makes the entire Drive experience work seamlessly.

Current Projects:
We’re currently focused on developing SDK that encapsulate the core functionality of Proton Drive. The SDK comes with two core implementations, one in C# for desktop and mobile clients and second in TypeScript for web client, and higher-level modules in Rust. Our SDK primarily serve internal clients today, but our long-term vision includes integrating them across the Proton ecosystem—and even enabling third-party applications to interface with Drive.

Tech Stack and Tools:
Languages we see daily is C#, TypeScript and Rust. We also need to provide bindings for Swift and Kotlin. We use Grafana and Prometheus to instrument our SDK, Sentry to get details issues from the SDK usage, GitLab CI for running tests including e2e tests written using Playwright, or GitLab in general to work on the code base.

Future Plans:
We are planning to revamp our cryptographic model to boost performance and efficiency across all clients. We will finish ongoing first generation of SDK to cover all core Drive features and new crypto model. Then we will do second generation in Rust with lessons learned and include full support of all features such as Photos, Public Sharing, and Docs.

Impact Opportunities:
Foundation work touches every aspect of Drive. The SDK and infrastructure you build will be used by every Drive client—and getting it right is both critical and deeply rewarding.
Drive is rapidly expanding. As it evolves into a true platform, we expect more teams to emerge—each owning different verticals built on top of Drive. This opens up immense opportunities to grow as an IC, tech lead or engineering manager.
You’ll have the chance to shape not only the future of Drive, but also your own career path in a variety of domains and technologies.

As a Senior Drive Foundation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining the foundational components that power Proton Drive applications. You will work collaboratively with Drive teams, including backend, web, mobile, or desktop developers, to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across various client applications.

What you will do:

Architect and develop core libraries: Lead the design and development of core C#/TypeScript/Rust libraries that serve as the backbone for Proton Drive's applications.
Cross-platform compatibility: Ensure compatibility and optimal performance across various platforms.
Code review and optimization: Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure code quality, maintainability, and performance optimization.
Collaboration: Work closely with backend, frontend, mobile and desktop developers to integrate core libraries seamlessly into Proton Drive's applications.
Testing: Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies, including unit tests and integration tests, to ensure the reliability of core libraries.
Documentation: Create and maintain thorough documentation for core libraries to assist other developers in understanding and utilizing the components.

Job requirements:

5+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on the Rust programming language.
Strong expertise in Rust language features, concurrency, and ownership models.
Web, mobile, and/or desktop development: Experience in developing libraries for client applications.
Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and excellent communication skills.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues efficiently.

Even if you don’t meet all the requirements listed above, but feel you could still be a great fit, please still apply.

What We Offer

Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here)
Work with smart and dedicated people - Our team is diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit with people coming from all walks of life, including many of the world’s top academic institutions and organizations, such as MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, and ETH.
Technology: you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
Learning & Development: we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
Employee Benefits: your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
Stock Options: at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
In-Person Collaboration: Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
Food: Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
Transport: getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
Flexible Working: you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit our privacy policy page .

new_jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect
new_jobs.description:
NTT DATA
es una consultora multinacional que ofrece soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría.

Digital Technology
es la unidad enfocada a acompañar a las grandes organizaciones iberoamericanas en su transformación digital, generando dividendos digitales a través de la tecnología y el diseño, con enfoque práctico y orientado al negocio. Para lograrlo, buscamos personas que compartan nuestra curiosidad permanente, pasión por la tecnología, excelencia constante y visión estratégica.

Digital Architecture
es la división que proporciona la estrategia tecnológica y las plataformas IT necesarias para impulsar la digitalización y transformación de nuestros clientes, ofreciendo soluciones cloud-native y siendo referentes en la construcción de arquitecturas robustas, seguras y que contemplen todas las necesidades.

Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo de arquitectura en Azure
y buscamos perfiles capaces de diseñar soluciones que combinen innovación, gobierno y fiabilidad operativa. Personas con criterio para conectar necesidades de negocio, requisitos regulatorios y decisiones tecnológicas, construyendo arquitecturas preparadas para evolucionar. Como Microsoft Gold Partner
, en NTT DATA impulsamos soluciones sobre Azure que combinan innovación tecnológica, gobierno y cumplimiento normativo. Trabajamos en proyectos donde la nube debe integrarse de forma realista con entornos existentes, modernizar aplicaciones críticas y habilitar plataformas empresariales escalables, seguras y conectadas con el ecosistema Microsoft.

¿Qué nos gustaría que aportaras?
Aunque no todo es imprescindible, nos gustaría que contaras con:
Al menos 5 años de experiencia diseñando y evolucionando arquitecturas cloud sobre Microsoft Azure
, en entornos empresariales complejos.
Conocimiento sólido de los servicios esenciales de Azure para el diseño de soluciones: identidad, redes, cómputo, almacenamiento, bases de datos, integración, observabilidad, seguridad y gobierno.
Experiencia aplicando principios del Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework
y definiendo arquitecturas escalables, resilientes, seguras y eficientes.
Capacidad para diseñar y evolucionar entornos híbridos, conectando Azure con infraestructuras on-premise , otras nubes y el ecosistema Microsoft.
Experiencia en la definición de landing zones , modelos de gobierno, estructuras de suscripciones, políticas, gestión de identidades y controles de cumplimiento.
Conocimiento de estrategias de modernización y migración de aplicaciones, valorando alternativas basadas en servicios PaaS, contenedores, arquitecturas serverless o plataformas gestionadas.
Criterio para abordar decisiones de seguridad y cumplimiento: Microsoft Entra ID, gestión de secretos, segmentación de red, cifrado, monitorización, auditoría y protección de cargas.
Capacidad para colaborar con equipos de ingeniería, plataformas, ciberseguridad, datos y responsables de negocio, facilitando decisiones técnicas alineadas con los objetivos del proyecto.

También valoraremos positivamente:
Certificaciones de Microsoft Azure, especialmente Azure Solutions Architect Expert
, o experiencia práctica alineada con sus dominios de conocimiento.
Experiencia con infraestructura como código y automatización mediante Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates o Azure DevOps.
Conocimiento de Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Arc, plataformas de integración, arquitecturas orientadas a eventos o prácticas DevSecOps.
Participación en iniciativas de gobierno cloud, optimización de costes, Cloud Center of Excellence o evolución de modelos operativos.
Interés por las capacidades de datos e inteligencia artificial del ecosistema Azure y por su integración en arquitecturas empresariales.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
Diseñar arquitecturas objetivo en Azure que respondan a necesidades de negocio y equilibren seguridad, escalabilidad, disponibilidad, rendimiento, gobierno y coste.
Definir patrones, estándares y arquitecturas de referencia reutilizables para acelerar el diseño y la adopción de soluciones cloud.
Diseñar y evolucionar landing zones , modelos de gobierno y controles técnicos que permitan utilizar Azure de forma segura, ordenada y escalable.
Acompañar proyectos de modernización, migración e integración híbrida, ayudando a seleccionar el enfoque tecnológico más adecuado para cada caso.
Evaluar decisiones de arquitectura, identificar riesgos y proponer alternativas ante retos de conectividad, identidad, integración, cumplimiento o operación.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, plataformas y ciberseguridad para asegurar que los diseños se llevan a la práctica de forma consistente y sostenible.
Facilitar conversaciones entre equipos técnicos y responsables de negocio, transformando necesidades complejas en decisiones de arquitectura y roadmaps accionables.
Contribuir al desarrollo de la práctica de Azure mediante la compartición de conocimiento, la creación de activos reutilizables y la exploración de capacidades relevantes del ecosistema Microsoft.

🎓 Certificaciones bonificadas de los principales proveedores cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) y otras tecnologías.

📅 Jornada intensiva (8:00 a 15:00) los viernes y los meses de verano.

🌊 Programas solidarios y actividades sociales para impulsar un impacto positivo a través de nuestro portal de voluntarios The Blue Wave .
🔝 Un ambiente de trabajo excelente, que fomenta el compañerismo y la buena convivencia. Somos Global Top Employer 2025, y, en España, por 10º año consecutivo.
🌏 Innovación diversa y cultura inclusiva. En NTT DATA creemos que cada persona es única y apostamos por una cultura que valora la diversidad y fomenta un entorno donde todos podamos explorar y potenciar nuestra singularidad.

new_jobs.description:
Senior ServiceNow Developer/ Consultant

The opportunity

ServiceNow is a global tool used widely to manage business processes of Enterprise clients and our ServiceNow team is part of the global structure of EY as a Global Elite partner of ServiceNow. Involving different roles and stakeholders we provide our customers with the best consultancy and solutions.

As member of our team, based in the EY GDS Spain office in Málaga,
you would be a part of project teams involved in implementation, configuration and maintenance of NowPlatform allowing you to develop your technical and business skills in global environment. As Global Elite ServiceNow partner EY works with all types of modules of the platform, heavily using their features and developing custom solutions not yet built by others.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Senior ServiceNow Developer, you will be tasked with directing the development and implementation of intricate business processes. This also involves the analysis of business requirements at all stages of development. You may have the opportunity to lead a team of consultants during projects or design the architecture of ServiceNow solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you must possess a comprehensive understanding of the platform and exhibit confidence when working through implementation, customization or maintenance projects. This may be demonstrated through:

Outstanding knowledge of NowPlatform architecture with at least 3 years of professional experience
Experience in product customizations, integrations, implementation or maintenance
Experience in project activities as a Developer

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 3 years of ServiceNow implementation experience
Advanced ServiceNow CAD or CIS certification
Demonstrated experience with at least two programming languages (JavaScript, C#, Java or others)
Proven experience and advanced understanding of ITSM and HRSD
Showcased knowledge of Best Practices in Software Development
Thorough understanding of ITIL and Agile methodologies
Excellent communication skills in English (B2 – C1)

Ideally, you’ll also have

Spanish, German, French or other European languages would be an advantage but not mandatory
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technical field or economic field

What We Look For

We are looking to hire a Senior ServiceNow Developer/ Consultant, who is passionate about creating innovative and bespoke solutions for our clients. We value individuals who wish to expand their product knowledge, work with global stakeholders across different workflows of product, and potentially progress to architect, tech lead, dev lead, or project management roles. If you are keen on initiating discussions and overseeing projects right up to post go-live activities - we are looking for you.

What We Offer

In EY GDS Spain, we’re committed to fostering a vibrant environment where every team member can thrive. We provide a space for continuous learning and the flexibility to define your own success, empowering you to make a meaningful impact in your own way. Our diverse and inclusive culture values who you are and encourages you to help others find their voice.

Additionally, here’s what makes us stand out:

Empowering Career Development: Unlock your potential with tailored training and development programs designed to elevate your skills and propel your career forward. We invest in your growth because your success is our success.
Flexible Work-Life Integration: Enjoy the freedom of our hybrid work model, allowing you to blend professional responsibilities with personal passions. We understand that life is more than just work, and we support you in achieving that balance.
Comprehensive Well-Being Programs: Prioritize your health with our extensive wellness initiatives, including psychological support sessions and health resources. At EY GDS Spain, your well-being is at the heart of what we do.
Meaningful Volunteering Opportunities: Make a difference in your community through our engaging volunteering programs. Join us in giving back and creating a positive impact while building connections with like-minded colleagues.
Recognized Performance and Rewards: Celebrate your achievements with our recognition programs that honor both individual and team successes. We believe in acknowledging hard work and dedication, ensuring you feel valued every step of the way.

Join us at EY GDS Spain, where your journey is supported, your contributions are celebrated, and your future is bright.

To learn more about what we offer, visit our

Careers in Global Delivery Services | EY - Global
page.

About EY GDS

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is the hub of innovation, a technology powerhouse, a global talent center and a driver of operational excellence within EY, propelling EY’s purpose of building a better working world. With a robust network spread across 8 countries and 21 cities, EY GDS’ dynamic network of highly talented professionals leverage data, AI, and leading-edge technology to enhance EY's wide array of services in Assurance, Consulting, Tax and EY-Parthenon.

By seamlessly integrating with EY member firms across the globe, EY GDS contributes significantly to EY's purposeful and sustainable growth, delivering insights and solutions that foster trust in capital markets and create value for EY clients, society, and the planet.

EY GDS is all in to shape the future with confidence, addressing today's challenges, and anticipating tomorrow's needs. EY GDS is not just reimagining the future of work—it's actively building it, ensuring agility, efficiency, and resilience in an ever-evolving world.

If you are interested in being part of our team, we kindly invite you to submit your CV in English to apply for this position.

new_jobs.title: Backend Developer - Turkish Speaking
new_jobs.description:
About Codeway

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, Backend at Codeway, you will design, build, and operate the scalable backend services that power mobile apps and web experiences used by millions. You won't just write code; you will own features end-to-end - from initial system design and AI integration to deployment and production monitoring - with a strong focus on API quality, performance, and reliability.

Our environment is fast-paced, and we value engineers who can turn complex architectural challenges into simple, elegant, and maintainable solutions. The ideal candidate will be comfortable building backend services for mobile products and working with API-heavy consumer apps.

You will collaborate with mobile, product, AI, and DevOps teams to ship features end to end, bringing AI-powered capabilities into production where relevant.

What You’ll Be Doing

Design and implement scalable systems. Build high-performance backend architectures and microservices/RESTful APIs for mobile and web clients using Node.js and Python.
Own features end-to-end. Take full responsibility for the lifecycle of your services, from ideation and implementation through to deployment (GCP/Firebase) and continuous optimisation.
Integrate AI and media workflows. Deploy, monitor, and support LLMs and media workflows (STT/TTS, image/video/audio processing) in production, managing model serving, inference performance, and latency/cost tradeoffs.
Architect asynchronous workflows. Implement robust event-driven systems using queues and tasks to handle heavy media and AI workloads.
Simplify systems. Evaluate every component and process to remove unnecessary complexity and build minimalist, future-proof architectures.
Optimise performance. Proactively identify bottlenecks across distributed systems to improve latency, throughput, reliability, and costs.
Ensure backend quality. Establish robust error handling, security best practices, and end-to-end observability, and contribute to code quality through reviews, testing, and documentation.
Troubleshoot and stabilise. Debug issues and proactively improve system stability and observability in production environments.
Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with Mobile, Frontend, Product, DevOps, and AI teams to design and ship impactful features.

What You’ll Bring

Experience. 3+ years of professional experience as a Backend Engineer, with a track record of building consumer-facing products at scale.
Technical excellence. Strong hands-on proficiency in both Node.js and Python, with a deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
System design. Experience designing and working with microservices architectures and RESTful APIs, with a solid grasp of databases, data modelling, performance optimisation, and security best practices.
Infrastructure knowledge. Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as GCP, AWS, or Azure (GCP and/or Firebase preferred), with strong production debugging and observability habits.
AI familiarity. Experience deploying and optimising AI models in production, including familiarity with external AI APIs and their performance considerations.
Scale. Ability to contribute effectively in high-scale environments handling large volumes of traffic and data, with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Communication. Proficiency in English and Turkish, with the ability to explain complex engineering decisions and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical teams.
Education. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to have

Experience supporting mobile apps through backend APIs.
Experience with GCP tools such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, or App Engine.
Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
Familiarity with SSE or WebSockets for real-time communication.
Experience with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS.

What We Offer

The chance to work with a high-caliber, passionate international team building category-defining products
Full-time contract with competitive salary
Private health insurance, a generous meal card
Full visa & relocation support if you’re moving to Barcelona
Annual learning & development budget for courses, tools, or events that support your growth
Wellness perks, including sports budget and psychological consultations.
Free access to Codeway’s suite of apps across productivity, wellness, and education
A top-notch office in the heart of the city

Suporte Operacional de Nível 3: Assegurar a estabilidade e resolução avançada de incidentes aplicacionais e de infraestrutura em ambientes críticos, identificando a causa-raiz (Problem Management) e participando na escala de prevenção (on-call 24/7 fora do horário laboral).

Monitorização e Cumprimento de SLAs: Definir métricas de desempenho, supervisionar plataformas de observabilidade e implementar sistemas eficazes de alerta (Zabbix, Grafana, ELK) para garantir o cumprimento estrito dos SLAs de negócio.

Gestão de Capacidade e Arquitetura: Avaliar a carga aplicacional, propondo o redimensionamento de recursos de infraestrutura ou redefinições de arquitetura para acomodar o crescimento dos volumes de transações.
Agendamento e Orquestração de Processos: Parametrizar, monitorizar e manter os fluxos de processamento em lote (batch processing) através de ferramentas de agendamento corporativas.
Documentação Técnica e Procedimental: Redigir e atualizar documentação de arquitetura técnica, matrizes de fluxo, manuais operacionais e procedimentos de resposta rápida a incidentes.

Job Description

You will join the managed services team of a global technology company in Sofia, which runs the database platforms of 5–6 client organisations end to end. As the senior database engineer, you are theL3 expert for Microsoft SQL Server, and you also work hands-on on an Oracle estate of more than 50 instances (about 25 TB, mostly 19c, including RAC).

The team is cross-skilled: MS SQL Server is the main technology, and you are expected to understand how things work in Oracle and to operate it confidently.

Your Responsibilities

Act as the L3 expert for MS SQL Server across 5–6 client environments.
Administer and troubleshoot Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, replication and standalone instances.
Analyse and tune performance: queries, indexes, waits, blocking and resource use.
Run backup and recovery with native and third-party tools; test restores regularly.
Apply cumulative updates, upgrades and security hardening; manage logins and permissions.
Operate Oracle 19c SE/EE databases on Linux and Windows, including RAC, Grid Infrastructure and RMAN backups with a third-party backup tool.
Handle incidents, problems, changes and service requests under ITIL, in and out of business hours; record all work in ServiceNow.
Carry out proactive work: health checks, capacity reviews, backup verification and documentation.
Automate recurring tasks with T-SQL, PowerShell (e.g. dbatools) or Ansible.
Manage vendor cases with Microsoft and Oracle on behalf of the client’s customers.

Our Requirements

6+ years as an MS SQL Server DBA in production, with several years at expert (L3) level.
Hands-on experience with Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances and

replication.

Strong performance tuning, backup and recovery skills.
2+ years hands-on Oracle administration, including 19c, RAC and RMAN.
Working-level Windows Server and Linux administration.
T-SQL and PowerShell scripting.
Working in ITIL processes with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM tool.
Fluent English, written and spoken (C1).
Resident in Bulgaria and able to work from Bulgaria only.
Willing to take part in the standby rotation.

Standby and out-of-hours

You join the client team’s standby rotation for your technology: one to two slots per week, 12 hours on weekdays and 24 hours at weekends, with no more than 100 standby hours per month.
Standby is remote. Alerts arrive by phone from the first-line team, and you connect within the response target (15 minutes for critical incidents).
Planned change and maintenance work outside business hours is scheduled in advance, typically 5–15 hours per month.
Standby hours and out-of-hours work are compensated separately from the day rate.

Education – benefit from our know-how, learning courses and certificates and IT events – be part of the community of leaders of the industry and take part as a speaker or a visitor
